Fellow American,

**I need to be blunt with you today:** The Supreme Court’s decision in June turned on a spigot of online donations to Democrats that shows no sign of weakening between now and Election Day.

**As for us Republicans, we’re having a hard time securing the necessary donations from our donors to compete head-to-head with Democrats in some of the most expensive conteETS in the country.** Biden’s economy has adversely impacted the ability of our donors to give at the same levels that we saw in 2020. Friend,

I wanted to take a few minutes today to tell you a little bit about myself, my life story, and what’s never going to change.

**__My Upbringing__**
I was raised in Zachary, Louisiana where I was taught the values I live by today by my mother and father. Those same values that I fight for each and every single day to protect. Values like hard work, dedication, and putting God and family first in everything.

[](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=2255395e081547639d3c8075f0fa12fa&_e=ex5y9nM0VEuK1OfFxyr9mX9hHIw4nN6Uc4can416x-ChMRNnLE-J-LckX6q6cfjeU2CDj4R42bCqOa3365UKbi3aRcawdcUE-AxzntEQTxLPNvTp2epd5UVvLfdDuFoAKll4b37PW9BUBPJayjI-eIA0wRiqw1lURLjYMQLZFNPvOD0S3gttRBcLjrntO40Y5EJRpXphIyAfQVp8G1Gh4kATulpO2oQVePq5cEqLBoYJK9avQrUVlIZ8POpNnZZbId5QgLQxQPVYh8CGNNVJYJnokCuDvUmohZF02uhtAN5aO6X5O9IlZC4TnaRw86Eyk32h6m_c5whMObvyTvFKTmNZmULYzPOqEoablkr0tkhvQzfYi_ysLJ0nAZW4AESArpGD4rTkWCRlVVRWmqJevdCB3uS6WMYRdVv0tEiZWYJDGZs8ds33qRf69lriQq8-k96RSA19i0x6peKV6gqZeg%3D%3D)
After high school, I attended Vanderbilt University, graduated, and then went on to receive my law degree at the University of Virginia. I tell you that so you know that I know a little more about law than the average pink-haired woker would like you to believe.

**__So, what’d I do after college?__**
I was elected to five terms as State Treasurer where I managed the state’s $10.6 billion investment portfolios. I also oversaw local and state bond issues and returned millions of dollars in unclaimed property each year. Before I was Treasurer, I served as Secretary of the Department of Revenue, Special Counsel to Governor Roemer, and Secretary of Governor Roemer’s Cabinet.

body:
Biden's ultimate goal is to label you and every other MAGA
Republican as a terrorist.

Peter:
Biden's and the Left's ultimate goal is to
label you and every other MAGA Republican as a terrorist.
It's already started.
ULTRA-MAGA!!!
SEMI-FASCISTS!!!!
FAR-RIGHT INSURRECTIONISTS!!!!
And it's not going to stop until you are
rounded up, declared an "enemy of the state," and forced to spend
the next 3-5 years in a government re-education camp until you
renounce your America First views.
Never before has so much rested on the
outcome of an election than the one coming up in less than 60
days. I'm not exaggerating.
We need to win and show Biden, Pelosi, and
the radical Left that we refuse to bow to their Marxist idol. The
best way to do it is to help me end my quarter strong with your
$25, $50, or $100 donation today and then win in November!
Look, all of their efforts from mandates to
intimidation tactics are intended to keep you down and dependent
on the government to control you and your family for generations
to come.
Because we know who the real danger to
democracy is - it's Grandpa Joe and Nancy Pelosi!
I bet George Orwell didn't think his fiction
books would be prophetic, but here we are today. So if you want
ANY hope of taking back our nation this November then I need you
to help me finish out my end-of-quarter strong or risk living in
a Marxist nightmare.
That's why I need your help to help me meet
my end-of-quarter goal before October 1st. So much is at stake!
I'm $42,082.71 away from meeting my target.

CHIP IN $50

CHIP IN $100

CHIP IN $250

I get up every day hoping to remind my
colleagues that we are in Washington to work for the people.
That this is a country where we don't
investigate our political enemies.
That this is a country where we don't
weaponize the IRS to audit and seize your opponents' finances.
That this is a country where you don't abuse
your power to conduct political witch hunts or enrich your family
on the backs of the taxpayers who can barely afford their
groceries.
I'm ready to save our country from utter
destruction. But it requires I'm there in Congress after November
to remove Nancy Pelosi from the Speaker's chair, investigate
Hunter's laptop and impeach the Big Guy!
But I can only do that if you donate at least
$50 or more TODAY and help me meet my end-of-quarter goal before
October 1st.
The Democrats know I won't let them succeed
in destroying this country. That's why they're working overtime
to my defeat this November.
In fact, they've become more invested in
removing me from Congress than Gavin Newsom is in electric
vehicles or air conditioning for his office.
Thankfully, you've been by my side as I've
overcome attack after attack since coming to Congress, but I
still need your help to finish this election strong and defeat
the radical leftist opponent they've got nipping at my ankles.
They've funded his campaign with more than
$10 Million and I'm not going to leave anything to chance.
Please don't let this be the end of my days
in Congress or America as we know it. Stand up and help me fight
back! Donate TODAY!
Thank you. God Bless America.

Marjorie Taylor Greene
Congresswoman (R-GA)

name: Rep. Dana Criswell
subject: Help set our 2023 legislatives agenda
body:
The 2023 legislative session is quickly approaching, which means its time for the Mississippi Freedom Caucus to set our legislative goals. Earlier this year, the Caucus off
|
---
| | | | The 2023 legislative session is quickly approaching, which means its time for the Mississippi Freedom Caucus to set our legislative goals. Earlier this year, the Caucus officers traveled to Washington D.C. to meet with State Freedom Caucus Network officials and members of the House Freedom Caucus to discuss issues that affect our nation and our state.We have identified several important areas that we believe need to be addressed by the Mississippi Legislature, but we need your opinion and your help. The Mississippi Freedom Caucus is the only organized group of conservative legislators in Mississippi and our goal is to serve the people of Mississippi by sponsoring and supporting legislation that moves our state in a conservative direction.[Help set our 2023 legislatives agenda](https://www.votervoice.net/BroadcastLinks/Rvp0ntVR4jC6glYYIl0zYw)Our identified goals are;
* Make Mississippi a sanctuary for life by introducing legislation to remove any unnecessary obstacles for families that want to adopt and foster children.**(Sanctuary for Life)**
* Bring Educational Freedom to Mississippi through comprehensive legislation that allows money to follow the student, including private and home school options, expands and strengthens Mississippi’s existing charter school laws, and ensures that parents have full transparency in what is being taught in their children’s classrooms.**(Educational Freedom)**
* The Mississippi Freedom Caucus will only support spending on core functions of government. We will actively seek to amend or defeat legislation that does not make the necessary reforms to ensure that people’s money is not being wasted. **(Oppose Wasteful Spending)**
* Finish the cleanup of Mississippi’s voter rolls and make any additional changes needed to make our state’s elections secure. **(Secure Elections)**
* Oppose any legislation or money that comes from the Biden-Pelosi-Cornyn gun control bill. We also call upon our Attorney General and Governor to reject any funding or impositions on our state sovereignty that come from this assault on our Second Amendment Rights. **(Oppose Gun Control)**
* Mississippi must ban its pension funds from being invested by companies that rely on woke Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) metrics that prize adherence to leftist ideology over the maximum return for taxpayers. **(Oppose ESG)**
* We will oppose any attempts to expand Medicaid to provide able-bodied-adults welfare or free healthcare. **(Oppose Medicaid Expansion)**

[Rank our 2023 legislative goals by importance](https://www.votervoice.net/BroadcastLinks/Rvp0ntVR4jC6glYYIl0zYw)
---

Peter,

By now, you probably know my story. But for those of you who don't remember, please allow me to refresh your memory. **It was Friday, August 21, 2015\. I boarded train #9364 in Brussels, bound for Paris. My plans were simple, and spirits were high. I was on vacation with my two best friends after completing a tour in Afghanistan as a U.S. soldier.**

But someone we didn't expect boarded the train that day too, and he would change our lives forever.

Ayoub El-Khazzani, an ISIS terrorist emerged from the bathroom, bare-chested and armed with a box cutter, an assault rifle, a jar of gasoline, and 270 rounds of ammunition attempted to take over and kill more than 500 passengers.

**And he would have succeeded, except he didn't know three proud Americans were aboard and ready to fight like hell. I tapped my friend on the shoulder and said: 'Let's go.'**
**
I've fought like hell to protect the great nation that I call home, both in Europe and in Afghanistan. [Now, I'm fighting like hell to flip a long-held Democrat House seat Republican here at home in Oregon.](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60796760:s8zV3chNS:m:1:2237666910:3D8549B5AA6DD8F4F01135ED596B349A:r) **

But my opponent, well, she's got other plans for me. I nearly lost my life the day I tackled an Islamic terrorist, but in an odd way,**the vicious attacks on my personal character by my opponent are a bit harder for me to swallow.**

**I'm worried that the attacks are having an effect on our polling numbers, despite that none of what she says is true.** That's why we need to be able to show voters here at home how many people are supporting my campaign this year. Which brings me to why I'm writing to you today.**[I am hoping to win your personal endorsement. Your signal of support for my campaign will allow me to make the case to voters here at home that I really am who I say.](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60796760:s8zV3chNS:m:1:2237666910:3D8549B5AA6DD8F4F01135ED596B349A:r)**

[** ENDORSE ME FOR CONGRESS TODAY ➞ **](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60796761:s8zV3chNS:m:1:2237666910:3D8549B5AA6DD8F4F01135ED596B349A:r)
Right now, our homeland is in danger. Not from radical Islamic terrorists, but radical Democrats who want to fundamentally alter the fabric of this GREAT nation. Leftist legislation is assaulting our Nation, our communities, and the American Dream.

Right now Democrats are ...
1. Opening and destroying our borders. They are granting dangerous amnesty that have and will continue to flood every corner of America.
2. Raising our taxes like we have never seen and making common goods like gas and groceries unaffordable.
3. Indoctrinating the American people with their woke, Leftist ideology
4. Teetering on the edge of dangerous foreign policy crises

[](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60796760:s8zV3chNS:m:1:2237666910:3D8549B5AA6DD8F4F01135ED596B349A:r)
These power-hungry Democrat elitists like Nancy Pelosi and Joe Biden don't care about the people they represent. They only care about their own radical agenda, and my opponent, **Val Hoyle will be another one of their foot soldiers.**

I can put a stop to it, but I need you on my team. **[My opponent is spending $40,000+ a week to attack my character in an attempt convince voters that I'm evil.](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60796760:s8zV3chNS:m:1:2237666910:3D8549B5AA6DD8F4F01135ED596B349A:r)** Your endorsement today will go a long way in helping me to convince voters that the lies she is peddling are just that, lies.

[** ENDORSE ME FOR CONGRESS TODAY ➞ **](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60796761:s8zV3chNS:m:1:2237666910:3D8549B5AA6DD8F4F01135ED596B349A:r)
My life's mission has always been to represent the America I know and love - the world's bastion of freedom and economic prosperity. **[I am taking that mission and putting it into action by running for Congress, by fighting for my neighbors and their wellbeing in Washington.](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60796760:s8zV3chNS:m:1:2237666910:3D8549B5AA6DD8F4F01135ED596B349A:r)**

This will not be an easy road, which is why I am reaching out to you. I will need the support of every American patriot to win this battle.**[Can I count on you to personally endorse my campaign for Congress immediately?](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60796760:s8zV3chNS:m:1:2237666910:3D8549B5AA6DD8F4F01135ED596B349A:r)**

Thank you,

Alek Skarlatos
Republican for Congress

P.S. - I would truly appreciate seeing your name on the growing list of supporters who have personally endorsed me. **[Every single endorsement matters in this race.](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60796760:s8zV3chNS:m:1:2237666910:3D8549B5AA6DD8F4F01135ED596B349A:r)**

# Send a Green Beret to take Capitol hill
JOIN US AT THE NC VETERANS' FORUM North Carolinians understand that Veterans get things done – that is why we want you to join us this THURSDAY, September 22 at 11:30am EDT, for our North Carolina Veterans Forum at American Legion Post 386. Join together with fellow Vets, military families and all patriotic North Carolinians in helping us to elect veterans to the U.S. Congress. There is no better place to execute that mission than in North Carolina's 6th District! **Special Guest: Chris Castelli,
Green Beret & Candidate for Congress (NC-06)** Senior RNC staff will be on hand to talk about the critical races that Republican veterans are running throughout the United States. Attendees will be introduced to some incredible new campaign technology that enables volunteers to reach more voters than ever before -- by phone or at their door. Join us for a evening of fellowship and help us send more Veterans to Washington -- and stick around for a BBQ lunch after the event! name: Ron Johnson
subject: a personal plea
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ron Johnson For Senate, Inc
body:
I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks.
[View this message in your browser](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z3358jv50hvqo4un2pqg5fes36h37iduoi7sqrmo_rp22sh2s8i66or6cdjmcob4cth238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuij78bielqr0sbiegqb7ctl6tr779hnmmrq8cjm62qb6t9nkjhf4ongmtib1p75e5ob4spge1or4sr3eppmecjhm4oeaoj4c9h6ap7765r74sj5eoojfduie1p68dhgm9j74t1hepge1d3563gbacb4spj6cc9imdhm0sjjcoqm9cr56uobapbi4no)

|
---
| | | Friend,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

Peter,

I know you're busy, but I need just a few minutes of your time.

__**[This is why I'm running.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61336124:6GLEV7VNx:m:1:3317145305:9DCD244D89310B7687A8461B698A151A:r "This is why I’m running.")**__

I grew up on a small farm in Washington.

We didn't have much, but I learned the value of hard work at a young age. I learned _responsibility_. That is something that political elites will never understand.

As a former triage nurse, I have always been passionate about serving others in my community.

However, everything was tested when a suicide bomber in Iraq permanently blinded my husband, Scotty, and I was told his service was over.

That's how I found myself running against a 30-year Democrat incumbent because we deserve better.

With empty grocery shelves and unprecedented crime, I couldn't sit on the sidelines any longer.

_**[This country is worth serving and sacrificing for, but I need YOUR endorsement to continue my fight!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61336124:6GLEV7VNx:m:1:3317145305:9DCD244D89310B7687A8461B698A151A:r "This country is worth serving and
sacrificing for, but I need YOUR endorsement to continue my fight!")**_

I'm not asking for money. _Today, all I 'm asking for is your endorsement. _

subject: My story in pictures
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
I wanted to share these special moments with you.
[View this message in your browser](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zabnk07svg0aj29b43og1aonih4eh608ei1isgh8_rp22sh2s8i66or6cdjmcob4c9h238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuij79hnmer7acjjegon9crl6crn2ct66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2uhgm6d75mkrbec9jm1pj1o37c2o6fchledon7d1km6pn0p1ksoon2cpgegq7edtnq9o74p1m62p6csjk65r61o5kckoe1d9hcjj6cphh6apm6o3iedj3ap5jc5jr1db5e8iv0)

| |
---
| | | Friend,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2ztndgtl5pld6vai3ao01usqsjesvhelga8j7asqo_rp22sh2s8i66or6cdjmcob4c9h2bs "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z2s8j4b57e88s6rhrqghqftm1i33lcq76qkuikd0_rp22sh2s8i66or6cdjmcob4c9h2bs "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zkeh3dqhbrn35ksdl8nn4ui5m7809fuaulmsjh9g_rp22sh2s8i66or6cdjmcob4c9h2bs "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zr8uafumcb3prd93erdu5d02r9s9fl3qjflksngg_rp22sh2s8i66or6cdjmcob4c9h2bs "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zhckv2b4f24ppgd3u4vr2skbnncpvl4qpqqciesg_rp22sh2s8i66or6cdjmcob4c9h2bs "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zi69c0pvg60choaqg1g5j6g91khujh4fp1frbga0_rp22sh2s8i66or6cdjmcob4c9h2bs "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z9r6jnh0ie6ki4v7i6i2hdr40o9vsodm7488nlp8_rp22sh2s8i66or6cdjmcob4c9h2bs "I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

name: Gabby Giffords
subject: I have not lost my voice
body:
Hi Derek,
11 years ago, I was shot.
The bullet damaged the left hemisphere of my brain, where the language function sits. Ever since, Aphasia has been a part of my life. When I speak, the words are there. It’s just hard for me to get them out.
Aphasia makes it harder for me to speak. But I have not lost my voice.
With a lot of practice I have found new ways to communicate. Through it all, Mark has been my rock. At every step of my journey, he has been there — pushing me, supporting me, making me laugh. And now, it’s my turn to help him.
I know a thing or two about tough campaigns. And I can tell you one thing for sure: This one is going to be close.
Super PACs and National Republicans are spending millions of dollars to help Mark’s opponent take back Arizona’s seat. So, I’m asking:
Splitting $25 – or anything you can afford – between Mark's campaign and CommonGood will go a long way in helping Mark win re-election to continue fighting for the issues we care most about in the Senate. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_mk?refcode=20220920_CGVA_Kelly]

subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. This sponsored message from Conservative Liberty Wire is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f4b981e11f714ae9b481a61a736ec06f&_e=3jED7gerdBzCIoVFod_63L87ygzE26KzFXHaphUHVw6mksD7tx1U5TFRv1kLUH-IvXhKiWU9sUDY-MhEK8y1VxAce-w5ZtjsE9uQupHrRnn4jhJfYfq_ldPChw_zPczRmv7OpFEznmTrxvTZ-jg7H0Es8b58QKPhl_-uGT0XkMSGvx8hDzQQl2VmEqIoKYLLHPm4p8tiO2cVHIq30_MwwmE8dxN7kX2JppvhMaKGraap2wpk5N0nANHQvJCze_x5VWgAxgqPIMZnG8hwIvYHgzBN8y_xjYrf5bwfeDS1An15GVaqH4x52QLVJNEMzWQEnSeFWy5TC5Svmm3zsb84uf7AGLRWs6PKGQgHomSyn4_wC08en9crM2UMKejA2cByjjBpuPEltFbMSYmuoV4hGA%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American,
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.
It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.
A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.
That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.**
By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.
You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below:
**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f4b981e11f714ae9b481a61a736ec06f&_e=3jED7gerdBzCIoVFod_63L87ygzE26KzFXHaphUHVw6mksD7tx1U5TFRv1kLUH-IvXhKiWU9sUDY-MhEK8y1VxAce-w5ZtjsE9uQupHrRnn4jhJfYfq_ldPChw_zPczRmv7OpFEznmTrxvTZ-jg7H0Es8b58QKPhl_-uGT0XkMSGvx8hDzQQl2VmEqIoKYLLHPm4p8tiO2cVHIq30_MwwmE8dxN7kX2JppvhMaKGraZOOC7vvwv6B9CT06UEcSxMeaZ3qvzjq0xdxUfQu0DgViQy1uHl_dai0HHW31ievvQ4blykZWS5O0zU-iz6TbIR573mWh6nwJS6j_S90o46s8BqTAqc0cpd5LEa-RQtapxClV6zHHEy_kENQfBxl149kgf8YlZ-0RLobUIOIAzIxw%3D%3D)**
For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.
**But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.**
This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.
Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states.
These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale's Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College.
**And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.**
So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.
**You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:**
**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f4b981e11f714ae9b481a61a736ec06f&_e=3jED7gerdBzCIoVFod_63L87ygzE26KzFXHaphUHVw6mksD7tx1U5TFRv1kLUH-IvXhKiWU9sUDY-MhEK8y1VxAce-w5ZtjsE9uQupHrRnn4jhJfYfq_ldPChw_zPczRmv7OpFEznmTrxvTZ-jg7H0Es8b58QKPhl_-uGT0XkMSGvx8hDzQQl2VmEqIoKYLLHPm4p8tiO2cVHIq30_MwwmE8dxN7kX2JppvhMaKGraZwWLtWcsWVTAc0YRDUTHOu_gbQw-un8M1nw7ur7oSFfr4Nr_HT99cpMSNOJdYbWlQpWFtT31CsoJ9E5a8Xt7jAlTjfUdvRUpyt5K2Oyah8_80kIEmGQEgY4PDoozsaH1BoU3Izuu2qLsa9FyC1-J-TcaijBKGcE_OATHnhZbSbzA%3D%3D)**
And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.
Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.
The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.
Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Well, I must admit I’d never heard this one before.
Stephen Colbert just called my Republican opponent “the kookiest, zaniest, conspiracy wacko this side of nutso Banana Junction.” I’m not one for name calling, but Colbert is right.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51001066/367955528/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk1675-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjZTdmMjliNi1mMDM4LWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Tif4v7g2rCAVLSoQ_LMlxYlkFiDbpdj66K_OEwUcN6E=)

Peter, a lot of people know of me, but they don't know how I got here or why they should put their faith in me to lead. After 8 years of service as a U.S. Army Apache pilot, I returned home to my community to run the company that my dad started - an automotive supply-chain company. I worked hard, created good-paying American jobs, met the love of my life — my wife Liz — and started a family.

But I couldn’t remain on the sidelines. Even though my military career was over, I felt like I had more to give. I wanted to continue to serve the country and my community in any way that I could. _I never envisioned myself as a politician. _ But after watching Washington fail to deliver on promises for decades, I decided that I had to take action. name: American Update
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c0723%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=QzH50qBjJW9A92uDUinL2A&sysid=1)
This sponsored message from American Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34573%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=lSi4kugrvG9IqwKlEP1Xfw&sysid=1) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34574%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=TTY9mwuRye7knvkq0I%2feIA&sysid=1)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. body:
| |
---
| | | Peter,

This is a longer email than usual but for the past months, I have become the #1 target of the Left, the liberal biased media, and Big Tech giants like Facebook, Twitter, and YouTube.

I have been smeared again and again by media companies like The New York Times, Washington Post, and the Milwaukee Journal Sentinel where they distort my comments, twist them through a liberal prism, and omit most of what I actually say.

I have been silenced, censored, and suspended by the social media oligarchs because I tell the truth, and oftentimes, it is the truth the liberal mainstream media does not want to hear. It counters their narrative, and they refuse to allow it. So they silence free speech.

Yet, despite all of this unconstitutional collusion between these far-Left parties working for political gain at the expense of the American people, I will not give up. They will not deter me.
And that is why I decided to run for re-election.

I am running for a third term for the simple reason that I believe I am the best person for the job. I believe that I am the best candidate to address the national debt, work to lower inflation, secure the border, and fight for America First policies. I believe I am the best candidate to put an end to the Biden administration's constant record of misinformation and their continued lack of transparency with Congress, the press, and you. body:
It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future.
[View this message in your browser](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zkb8glfhisr8he43kkfff6dlfq1i1a0edf11t1n0_rp22sh2s8i66or6cdie8ob2c1h238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuij78bielqr0sbiegqb7ctl6tr779hnmmrq8cjm62qb6t9nkjhf4onmedqb3dj26uo67cb6ekqr4djhe9ir2crks1r30t1m6kqb6c3lmpon7cr76dpbfduie1p68dhgm9j74t1hepge1d3563gbacb4spj6cc9imdhm0tr1coqm1cr0cuobapbi4no)
This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zs2n36rs5mpro7ppju980ru71vosnsh515q1lvlo_rp22sh2s8i66or6cdie8ob2c1h2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2za1ovio0crlqpicgvruiih8dt4arkprb9bvftno8_rp22sh2s8i66or6cdie8ob2c1h2bs)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zkgla28n4bm4mvje3fatf6ieuglc6ebcu7fbvu2g_rp22sh2s8i66or6cdie8ob2c1h2bs)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

clean_body: | | | Hey everyone - I want to make a quick request since we now have fewer than 50 days until Election Day. Can you believe it? This year has been a non-stop whirlwind full of great events and great people — and I promise to work just as hard for you in Congress as I am on the campaign trail.With that being said, this campaign is coming down to the wire so I wanted to ask you if you could make a contribution to the final push of my campaign. | I immigrated from Soviet Ukraine, attended Baltimore public schools, worked my way through college and graduate school, and served for 14 years in the defense and intelligence community. I achieved my American Dream, and I’m running to help others achieve theirs.Please spread the word about my candidacy — forward this email to friends who may want to learn about my campaign! Thank you for all your support. Karina Lipsman Nominee Virginia’s 8th Congressional District PS: My team wanted me to invite you to some of our great upcoming events. body:
Convicted child sex abusers are not welcome to play with our children!

View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/votetylerlee/congresswoman-adams-lawless-behavior-7342953?e=4ed8243e91)
https://secure.anedot.com/b5c81bee-6e5f-4118-91cb-3dab5c3f0037/drag-queen-story-hour-canceled?utm_source=Tyler+Lee+for+Congress&utm_campaign=6b4f821da2-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_07_19_10_56_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_ac8d25e432-6b4f821da2-617881201
Fellow Patriot,
If there’s a venomous snake in a room that a child is crawling in, I’m going to raise the alarm and then cut the snake’s head off.

So that’s why I protested the Drag Queen Story Hour at the Romare Bearden Park this weekend—and our efforts resulted in the event being canceled on the second day!

I put together an Instagram reel highlighting our protest, which can be watched here (https://www.instagram.com/reel/Cin0VumAvUf/?utm_source=Tyler+Lee+for+Congress&utm_campaign=6b4f821da2-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_07_19_10_56_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_ac8d25e432-6b4f821da2-617881201) :

Let’s be straight, I don’t care if people play dress up in private, but our elected officials should not be using taxpayer dollars to fund the potential exposure of our children to pedophiles in our public parks!

Yet Charlotte City Council LaWana Mayfield has publicly called me a bigot for speaking out to protect our children. She called my concerns nonsense, and claimed the facts about pedophiles ‘are only one click away’ on the keyboard...
https://secure.anedot.com/b5c81bee-6e5f-4118-91cb-3dab5c3f0037/drag-queen-story-hour-canceled?utm_source=Tyler+Lee+for+Congress&utm_campaign=6b4f821da2-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_07_19_10_56_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_ac8d25e432-6b4f821da2-617881201
She sent me a link identifying pedophiles as 30+ aged white heterosexual males. This didn’t seem like a ‘diverse’ or receptive response from her, and the resource seemed slightly narrow-minded. So, I did a bit more clicking around on the internet...

Does this look like bigotry to you?
https://secure.anedot.com/b5c81bee-6e5f-4118-91cb-3dab5c3f0037/drag-queen-story-hour-canceled?utm_source=Tyler+Lee+for+Congress&utm_campaign=6b4f821da2-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_07_19_10_56_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_ac8d25e432-6b4f821da2-617881201
As you can see, there have been numerous instances where convicted child sex abusers have been found (https://duckduckgo.com/?q=drag+queen+pedophile&atb=v314-1&ia=web&utm_source=Tyler+Lee+for+Congress&utm_campaign=6b4f821da2-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_07_19_10_56_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_ac8d25e432-6b4f821da2-617881201) as playing a role in these events, realizations made after the fact. This is not an act of bigotry; it is an act by a caring adult on behalf of children made vulnerable by such events.

LaWana claims that her “diverse experience has taught her the value of listening to the concerns of the public and connecting those concerns with resources” on her campaign website. This kind of political talk doesn’t pass muster, especially where there’s no walk to follow it. The American people are sick and tired of it!

Enough is enough!

Our children deserve to have adults in their lives who will fight for their safety and innocence by rising above the fear of being labelled as misogynist and homophobic zealots.

Thank you to everyone who sent emails and joined with me in taking a stand against this developmentally inappropriate exposure to children.

Our protest achieved success!
Now, I’ve reached out to our state representatives requesting legislation to ban Drag Queen performances from taxpayer funded public places and for any individual under the age of 21.

When we boldly take a stand for our children, exercising our First Amendment rights can create a safer world for them!

My opponent Alma Adams would rather act as a cheerleader for Planned Parenthood while they offer transgender hormone therapy to our children
than reject this encroachment of predators after our most precious national resource.

In November, advocates of children can reject Adams for abandoning them.

When elected as your next Congressman, I will unabashedly continue to fight for the protection of our children!

Join me in the battle to safeguard the well-being of our children by supporting my campaign with a donation of any amount today:

DONATE $15 » (https://secure.anedot.com/b5c81bee-6e5f-4118-91cb-3dab5c3f0037/drag-queen-story-hour-canceled?amount=15&utm_source=Tyler+Lee+for+Congress&utm_campaign=6b4f821da2-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_07_19_10_56_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_ac8d25e432-6b4f821da2-617881201)

Friend,

I know you're busy, but I need just a few minutes of your time.

__**[This is why I'm running.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z7avvbigsfsh3a88sjr85dthj3v0njqbukmfde70_rp22sh2s8i66or6cdie8ob4c3h2bs "This is why I’m running.")**__

I grew up on a small farm in Washington.

We didn't have much, but I learned the value of hard work at a young age. I learned _responsibility_. That is something that political elites will never understand.

As a former triage nurse, I have always been passionate about serving others in my community.

However, everything was tested when a suicide bomber in Iraq permanently blinded my husband, Scotty, and I was told his service was over.
_**The suicide bomber may have taken my husband's vision, but he didn 't take away our determination and drive for service over self.**_
That's how I found myself running against a 30-year Democrat incumbent because we deserve better.

With empty grocery shelves and unprecedented crime, I couldn't sit on the sidelines any longer.

_**[This country is worth serving and sacrificing for, but I need YOUR endorsement to continue my fight!](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zq5tqdp9j34egok1g3efjhlv54e2sdgaqjnt031g_rp22sh2s8i66or6cdie8ob4c3h2bs "This country is worth serving and sacrificing for, but I need YOUR endorsement to continue my fight!")**_

I'm not asking for money. _Today, all I 'm asking for is your endorsement. _

---
| | [ENDORSE TIFFANY SMILEY](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zd1jo5o758qp29p3bttr2egvuaqi2r1i46ncptjg_rp22sh2s8i66or6cdie8ob4c3h2bs "ENDORSE TIFFANY SMILEY")
---

We're just weeks away from the General Election, and I know the odds are against me.

However, I genuinely believe that America needs to restore its core values. If you think that too, please, _**[endorse me and join our team.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z0bie8at26oiak4s4aqfr4i5j1bdaiu5v8qnrle0_rp22sh2s8i66or6cdie8ob4c3h2bs "endorse me and join our team.")**_

It would mean the world to me.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---
Peter,

I wanted to take a few minutes today to tell you a little bit about myself, my life story, and what's never going to change. **__My Upbringing__**
I was raised in Zachary, Louisiana where I was taught the values I live by today by my mother and father. Those same values that I fight for each and every single day to protect. Values like hard work, dedication, and putting God and family first in everything.

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61343067:63IGf7V9N:m:1:3317145305:EBBEE2999D175521AF6529A7F209C393:r)
After high school, I attended Vanderbilt University, graduated, and then went on to receive my law degree at the University of Virginia. I tell you that so you know that I know a little more about law than the average pink-haired woker would like you to believe.

**__So, what 'd I do after college?__**
I was elected to five terms as State Treasurer where I managed the state's $10.6 billion investment portfolios. I also oversaw local and state bond issues and returned millions of dollars in unclaimed property each year. Before I was Treasurer, I served as Secretary of the Department of Revenue, Special Counsel to Governor Roemer, and Secretary of Governor Roemer's Cabinet.

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61343067:63IGf7V9N:m:1:3317145305:EBBEE2999D175521AF6529A7F209C393:r)
Then, I got my biggest call. **The call to help the people of Louisiana and America.**

**_Time as U.S. Senator of Louisiana_**
I was elected to the U.S. Senate in 2016 after being endorsed by none other than President Donald J. Trump. I serve on the Appropriations, Banking, Housing and Urban Affairs, Budget, Judiciary, and Small Business and Entrepreneurship committees in the U.S. Senate. I serve as the Ranking Member on the Subcommittee of Energy and Water Development for the Appropriations Committee, the Ranking Member on the Subcommittee of Federal Courts for the Judiciary Committee, and the Ranking Member on the Subcommittee of Economic Policy for the Banking Committee.

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61343067:63IGf7V9N:m:1:3317145305:EBBEE2999D175521AF6529A7F209C393:r)
Every day for me is a new challenge, another day to serve the people of Louisiana, and another day to fight for our conservative values. You see, I'm always going to be **100% PRO-LIFE, PRO-GUN****,** and **PRO-FREEDOM**. That's not going to change regardless of what the Neo-Socialist Left throws at me and you can write that down and take it home to mama.

**I 'm going to fight for your rights, your freedoms, and for a better future for our children. **

That won't change, I'd rather drink weedkiller than let the Socialist Left Agenda poison this country that we know and love so much.

**[So, now that I've given you my story in a nutshell, I'm going to humbly ask for your support. I've got two Left-of-Lenin opponents running to defeat me because Nancy Pelosi likes me about as much as a cat likes swimming. I need you to rush whatever you're able below to make sure I have the resources necessary to fight for you and defend our nation.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61343067:63IGf7V9N:m:1:3317145305:EBBEE2999D175521AF6529A7F209C393:r)** | [**DONATE $500**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61343068:63IGf7V9N:m:1:3317145305:EBBEE2999D175521AF6529A7F209C393:r)

We talk a lot about FEC fundraising deadlines, so we wanted to take a moment to explain why they are so important to Mark Kelly’s chances.
#

Friends —
We talk a lot about FEC fundraising deadlines, so we wanted to take a moment to explain why they are so important to Mark Kelly’s chances.
After an FEC deadline, candidates are legally required to report how much money they’ve raised. Right now, our opponent doesn’t know what we’ve raised. And we don’t know what he’s raised either.
Our opponent’s campaign, PACs, and dark money groups could have raised absurd amounts of money they’re ready to spring on us. That could mean attacks ads on TV, on radio, online, on billboards — even blimps. Seriously.
You can bet outside groups will be looking to see what we’ve raised. They’ll want to know if we’re vulnerable. If we are, they’ll be more likely to attack. But if we file a strong report, they might pull back their spending.
That’s why these deadlines are so important — strategically and practically. Every campaign, national group, and Super PAC will look at these reports and make budget decisions.
So, we have to raise everything we can and exceed our September fundraising goals so we’re prepared to fight back in the final few weeks of the campaign.
And since these emails are the primary way Mark Kelly’s campaign raises money, it means we have to ask:
[**Can you please make a $3 contribution to Mark Kelly’s re-election campaign before this critical FEC fundraising deadline at the end of the month? | | Dear Fellow American, A few years ago, _New York _magazine posed the question: "When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?" This is, of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a "Great Reset" of our economy and our way of life. In a recent issue of _Imprimis_ --Hillsdale College's digest of liberty--author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as "'capitalism with Chinese characteristics'--a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below." Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for--and opposition to--socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. **Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zbo2t8n8uajidcbdd9r29he60ec795gq83i2qjdo_rp22sh2s8i66or6cdiecoj1c9h2bs)** Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that... **. . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages. ** **Why is this?** Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists. At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried. This is a result of the far-Left's "long march through the institutions"--including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media. Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory--which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race--are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale's work to **reach** and **teach** millions has never been more urgently needed. **That 's why I need your thoughts quickly. ** By responding to the **National Survey on Socialism **in the next five days**, **your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. As Winston Churchill said, "Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy." If you agree, please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Socialism** today. **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zcpupkb969qg0h3vij7u993mjoh9t5c4trm0i9u0_rp22sh2s8i66or6cdiecoj1c9h2bs)** Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember--**it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education**. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

It requires constant attention and vigilance from all who participate to make sure it continues year after year.

body:
Eric Lynn for Congress [https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP24/1/93680/images/lynn-email-logo.png]
Hi team,

On September 20, 2011, the discriminatory “Don’t Ask, Don’t Tell" policy was repealed. Today marks that important anniversary, ending a law that had only allowed LGBTQ+ service members to be in the U.S. armed forces if they kept their sexual orientation a secret.

I was proud to serve as Senior Advisor in the Pentagon in the Obama Administration at that time, and to help work on the repeal of this discriminatory law.

I am also extremely proud of all of the progress we made toward equality in those eight years in office.

As you may have seen in the news lately, Republicans are on a rampage to roll back the progress on LGBTQ+ rights. They've passed laws that limit the rights of LGBTQ+ individuals to get access to healthcare, play the sports they choose, and feel safe in public spaces.

No one, especially those who have given their lives in service of our country, should be targeted by their government simply for who they are or who they love.

I will always stand up and be an ally for the LGBTQ+ community. But, like many of you, I know that a Republican takeover of Congress in November will set us back astronomically. We can’t let that happen.

Will you help me continue to protect the rights of the LGBTQ+ community? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/el_dadt_ann?refcode2=29908dbd-0939-ed11-a27c-281878b83d8a&refcode=220920_el_dadt_l1]

Thank you for your support, team.

clean_body: Eric Lynn for Congress [] Hi team, On September 20, 2011, the discriminatory “Don’t Ask, Don’t Tell" policy was repealed. Today marks that important anniversary, ending a law that had only allowed LGBTQ+ service members to be in the U.S. armed forces if they kept their sexual orientation a secret. I was proud to serve as Senior Advisor in the Pentagon in the Obama Administration at that time, and to help work on the repeal of this discriminatory law. I am also extremely proud of all of the progress we made toward equality in those eight years in office. As you may have seen in the news lately, Republicans are on a rampage to roll back the progress on LGBTQ+ rights. They've passed laws that limit the rights of LGBTQ+ individuals to get access to healthcare, play the sports they choose, and feel safe in public spaces. No one, especially those who have given their lives in service of our country, should be targeted by their government simply for who they are or who they love. I will always stand up and be an ally for the LGBTQ+ community. But, like many of you, I know that a Republican takeover of Congress in November will set us back astronomically. We can’t let that happen. Will you help me continue to protect the rights of the LGBTQ+ community? [] join me here [] Thank you for your support, team. – Eric Lynn, Democratic Nominee for FL-13 Eric Lynn is a former Senior Advisor to President Obama, national security expert, small business owner, community advocate, and St. Petersburg Native who is ready to lead Pinellas County forward. subject: Lincoln’s secret weapon
body:
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Eucli
[View this message in your browser](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zkvgjj089rek9pcleeeltnseljdhgkflv5t0g5k8_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jk4qj4ttkumqn4s9nmorb79hnmmrq8cjm62qb6t9nkjhf4ongskqn8sj0mhob3d3jc5q3ad5i61g7cdb668rm8d3je1ie3d34eti69cjgekp6eduie1p68dhgm9j74t1hepge1d3563gbacb4spj6cc9imdhm0tr3coqe1cr66uobapbi46h22sh2s8i66or6cdiecoj2cph2bs)

---|---
| | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.”
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.”**
Through**“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.
---
| | **Now, the course is available in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or for use in a small group.** **** **You can receive the DVD box set as a thank-you for your tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.**
Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...
Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.
---

---

Quantities of this special DVD box set are limited, so reserve your copy today. I’ve included a secure link for you to make your tax-deductible gift below:
[_**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/dvd-mathematics-and-logic-course**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2ztp8psodjh0ensujo8h8cg3r0etj1srsu1e9p6gg_rp22sh2s8i66or6cdiecoj2cph2bs)
Thank you for partnering with Hillsdale in its mission on behalf of liberty.
Warm regards,
Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

subject: A message for parents and childcare givers

body:
https://www.lashrecseaird.com [https://www.lashrecseaird.com]
Friends,
If you’re like me, at this point in September you’re probably just starting to settle into your return to school routine. As parents of two school-aged boys, my husband and I are excited to see our children learn new things, make new friends, and discover new opportunities for their future. But we’re also contemplative, and we worry about the way they will be treated and what they will and will not learn this year.
We’ve listened continuously to Governor Youngkin reminding us that he supports all parents, but his actions have shown that the voices of parents like ours are unheard and ignored. On Friday evening, just as parents everywhere were beginning their weekend, his administration released the “2022 Model Policies on the Privacy, Dignity and Respect for All Students and Parents in Virginia’s Schools,” [https://doe.virginia.gov/support/gender-diversity/2022-model-policies-on-the-privacy-dignity-and-respect-for-all-students-town-hall.pdf] which do anything but model respect for parents and students.
Donate [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lashrecse]
These policies disrespect transgender students and their parents, stigmatize and traumatize students, and prevent a safe learning enviroment that all students should be entitled to. This latest stunt only builds on Youngkin’s hateful rhetoric that “divisive concepts”—i.e. accurate American history—should not be taught in schools.
The hate must stop. As a Delegate I was proud to vote for the Virginia Human Rights Act. I supported policies that focused on the real needs of our schools, like funding for modernization of school buildings, increasing school counselors, supporting principals, and so much more. I want our children to learn all of Virginia’s history, the good, the bad, and the ugly. And speaking of teachers, I want our teachers to be respected, trusted, and well paid.
Donate [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lashrecse]
As I reflect over these struggles as a parent, one thing is for sure—our work isn’t done yet. I’m running to be your next State Senator to continue the work to protect our children from this type of divisiveness, ensure they receive a top notch education, demand resources for our teachers and respect for other parents with a voice like mine.
The path forward isn’t easy, but as a mother, as a Virginian, and as your neighbor—I know it is worth it. As this school year starts for our children, I ask for your continued support to start a new chapter in the State Senate built on trust, integrity, and representation.
Sincerely,
Lashrecse

body:
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation
[View this message in your browser](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zor3jk90crjas9ipqe0l7rtrm7f0p8fc06lalgeo_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jk1p7fcdkmcqjas3h6gonact66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2umoefdlhmmrm2t3lekob6ttgc3hj8cdickprat3lcaq62p3jciqnacpgsaon0tpnq9o74p1m62p6csjk65r61o5kckoe1d9hcjj6cphh6apm6o3nclj38oljc9jr1db5e8gq48bi4bh28or3cphm9pb0cpgm49fg)
This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z9nep5jbjarff43mbd2v7hauddom6n49qhrqs6tg_rp22sh2s8i66or6cdieao36c5h2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zrjnt38eg483mcint8u4mer159h75p6idhoo0qjg_rp22sh2s8i66or6cdieao36c5h2bs)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zidkm5a2ubomrmciv6ksiael9afj1u7e08kjmfgg_rp22sh2s8i66or6cdieao36c5h2bs)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

body:
We got news this week that Florida Governor Ron DeSantis sent a large group of migrants to Martha's Vineyard, Massachusetts as a publicity stunt. | | | [](http://links.johnkasich.com/u/click?_t=6a3b28686d0a4d77958e12349305a4fe&_m=7aa3c21346ed4991bf11126e11f5d319&_e=RNr_EN8vhNtOlJ6AMnjFHLdDLpejBYD6cN-U99xFRvCXTKrnYQfIDtmCyn8lxI-kmrlPe7trYj-gCR2Cs2fyia-YCrO1_CTrurpf-6lSTu45ETaGSWsTQRAU23LHfyyEUiZyBEuJ0jtPRBncq5KaIerRwhiUG8ey-S-3SnPAA4rv7VPZ8LnwoypFMaS1pxJmhsDouxoOBKmjGPe1WYDjBw%3D%3D)
---
Peter, There's no doubt that we have a crisis on America's southern border as a surge of Illegal migrants are arriving, while Congress seems largely paralyzed on this issue. The common perception out there is that Democrats are doing little to secure the border and that Republicans want to take somewhat draconian moves that appear to lack compassion or understanding. Ultimately, these tactics by both sides are unimaginative and produce bad policy results. They both are rallying the more radical wings of their parties rather than coming together to solve this challenge, which is the only way to enact lasting reforms. We got news last week that Florida Governor Ron DeSantis sent a large group of migrants to Martha's Vineyard, Massachusetts as a publicity stunt. Texas Gov. Abbott has taken similar actions, sending migrants from Texas to other states this summer. There is no doubt that southern states are largely shouldering the burden of illegal immigration, **but have they gone too far with these attempts to force immigration reform by sending migrants to Democrat led-states in the north?** **To me, the answer is _YES_.**
---
| | [](http://links.johnkasich.com/u/click?_t=6a3b28686d0a4d77958e12349305a4fe&_m=7aa3c21346ed4991bf11126e11f5d319&_e=RNr_EN8vhNtOlJ6AMnjFHAeWvaUdKPSD_JmNnbWFqkkuDUVM18b0LTmTbQAX5oqMZ1f-mXUfgufHKHG5_ha20-ADNEQ5q_fpZc7RbQcZqYKASQCTdltb2vqv7PxR-EcpKzTSaDt7ylaWbyPBuHFJ8gUpVdm2LXjFnyGdp8Z3Xhu9pQLPyq6XIWsWQiAOJy0Qm6r2bn-XSp7C54yB1s5Vs_zVJjLCz0NrdmH2csaWw5MDCA5cAZmIcn5IebkHnJGKSdzRd5TIJAuE0Epr-rC_vffH11CtjpnihpqDNmM2em0%3D)

**The reason is because we seem to have forgotten the most important part of this whole debate:** **_We are talking about real human lives here_**. My grandparents were immigrants to America and I imagine that many of you may have similar stories from your own family. Our nation is a nation of immigrants and it is a good thing that people from around the world come to our country to create a better life for themselves and their children. **Some of America's most successful inventors, scientists, doctors and job creators are immigrants!** Our leaders in Washington are failing us by refusing to work together to pass comprehensive immigration reform. Instead, they work to further divide us on this issue. I'm out there every week giving speeches, doing media interviews, hosting my podcast, communicating on social media and using every other tool at my disposal to give hope and encouragement to as many Americans as I can. **The reason is simple:** I want to inspire people to come together and build-up those things that unite us instead of spending time on the things that divide us. clean_body: I wanted to make sure you heard from me. | | | Peter, I know you hear a lot from my husband, Hung, but I wanted to make sure you heard from me too. It’s incredible how hard my husband has worked throughout this campaign. He’s always working to create a better future for the people of Virginia and win this race, and his passion and energy is just as high as it was on day one. But all of our hard work will go to waste if we can’t meet our end of month fundraising goal next week. My husband, his campaign team, and patriots like you have put this race on the map, Peter. That means everyone is watching - and a lot of people are rooting for us to fail. If we don’t pull the numbers we need at the end of the month, people will lose faith in our campaign, and voters will start doubting if we have what it takes. This race is razor thin, and we can’t afford Virginians to have a sliver of doubt about us. Hung is putting in so much work to take back the House and flip Virginia red, and I know he has what it takes to win. ** Today is National Voter
------------------------------------------------------------

** Registration Day!
------------------------------------------------------------

Dear

As your Republican candidate for Secretary of the State, nothing is more important to me than the sacred right to vote. Today is National Voter Registration Day!

If you’ve recently moved, turned 18, became a U.S. citizen, or changed your name—you may not be eligible to vote in this year’s mid-term elections. Take 30 seconds to register to vote, check your registration status, or find a registration event on or offline near you! Visit NationalVoterRegistrationDay.org (https://dominicforct.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=8b114379a7&e=8763c56857) for more information.

Thank you and God bless our great state of Connecticut!

Dominic Rapini

Republican Candidate for Secretary of the State

name: Kristina Karamo
subject: News From the Trail, Another Full Week
body:
**What another busy week it 's been!**

Tuesday found me at the Capitol addressing two proposals on the November ballot, both of which deserve your hardy NO!
Wednesday found us on the west side of the state in Wyoming for a fundraiser.
On Thursday we headed to downtown Detroit for a gathering of local pastors.
**Friday** I toured the new vehicles on display at the NAIAS Auto Show down at The Huntington Place in Detroit.
Saturday we headed out to Livingston County to pump up the door knockers. What a great enthusiastic group! Then it was back to Detroit for the
Tour De-Troit event. Kristina had a great time engaging with these cyclists!
Sunday I was privileged to join Do Good Detroit for the "kick off" of their new group. They're a nonpartisan group encouraging millennials of all political affiliations to become civically engaged. Millennials are ready to stand-up and fix the common threat of government corruption to save our children's future! Freedom isn't partisan.

What a beautiful state we live in! I'm loving this cooler weather and watching Mother Nature getting ready to put on her annual fall show for us.

Catch us in **Muskegon on Friday** , where I'll be taking the stage with U.S. Congressional Candidate John Gibbs! 2330 Barclay St from 6pm to 9pm. Sign up: [https://www.muskegongop.com/event-details/freedom-roundup](https://rightstrategies.us/email/l/0Qky4uvr892tttSpAxJb8920tw/XzsAEN0sDKJM6y3zMEwQ0g/HbEmV6go763FJ90763763HwrPvuQ)

All across Michigan, people are wanting to get involved. You can, too! If you haven't signed up to volunteer, go to KristinaKaramo.com and join our team! Also, your financial investment will help ensure our victory in November and the saving of state and nation!

Right now, as many as1 in 4 Americanswho are qualified to vote have not registered. We need to change those numbers immediately if we want to keep our Democratic majority in Congress. Peter, I founded United Rural Democrats just over two years ago to support Democratic candidates, local parties, and voters across rural America. Since then, we've raised tens of thousands of dollars for candidates and local parties. I've traveled more than 150,000 miles to 47 states, meeting with voters and candidates to make sure we prioritize their needs in DC and statehouses. And, we've reached 250,000 voters to make sure no one feels left out in the political process. The difficult truth is that Republicans have been doing the same , and they're targeting rural voters by the thousands. We need to put up a fight, and that starts with one simple task: registering to vote. That's why I want to ask you, Peter, to reach out to your friends, family, coworkers, neighbors, and anyone else in your community to make sure they are registered to vote. Every single vote counts, and we need to make sure that every Democrat who is eligible to vote is registered. Next, I also want to ask you to consider donating to United Rural Democrats. My team and I have been working around the clock to reach as many rural voters as we can, but we need your help. ** If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your secure donation will go through immediately: Thank you for engaging in our democracy and adding your contribution today. – Joe Shepherd, President of URD United Rural Democrats (URD) is leading the effort to rebuild the Democratic Party in rural America. Will you support our network of activists on the ground as we work to rebuild our party's infrastructure and flip these areas blue?

This is a longer email than usual but for the past months, I have become the #1 target of the Left, the liberal biased media, and Big Tech giants like Facebook, Twitter, and YouTube.

Now that I have announced, the Left will seize every opportunity to destroy me politically. They will continue to write manipulative hit pieces and orchestrate smear campaigns across all mediums. They will attack and distort my record of success, my record of searching for the truth, and my record of fighting for the people of Wisconsin in any way they can. The Democrats even placed a $2M ad buy just moments after I announced my campaign for re-election.
