name: Lindsey Graham
subject: Protecting Pain-Capable Unborn Children from Late-Term Abortions Act
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Team Graham, Inc
body:
There is never a bad time to stand up for the unborn, and that's exactly what I'm doing with this legislation. | [](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60800032:WLpA4chN1:m:1:877327319:4857F374FE86AA73D7559098BCAB4A2C:r)
---
Dear Fellow American:

**Last week I introduced the _Protecting Pain-Capable Unborn Children from Late-Term Abortions Act_ in the United States Senate.**

The legislation sets a federal minimum protection for unborn children and bans abortion after 15 weeks when unborn children can feel pain. This new bill would put the United States' abortion policy in line with 47 of 50 European nations, including France, Germany, Belgium, Denmark, and Spain.

**Earlier this year, Democrats in the U.S. Senate voted in favor of federal legislation to allow abortions right up until the moment of birth. The Democrat Party's proposal is radical, barbaric, and opposed by 80% of Americans according to polling.**

Our legislation:
* Prohibits doctors from performing abortions after 15 weeks gestation - when an unborn child can feel pain - except in situations involving rape, incest, or risks to the life and physical health of the mother.
* Leaves in place state laws that are more protective of unborn life.
* Is supported by an overwhelming majority of Americans - 72% - who favor limiting abortions after 15 weeks with exceptions for rape, incest, and life of the mother. This strong support includes 75% of women, 69% of men, 70% of Independents, and 60% of Democrats.

The Supreme Court's decision in _Dobbs_ returned "the issue of abortion to the people's elected representatives." As Justice Kavanaugh wrote in his concurring opinion, the elected representatives can be "in the States or Congress."

Today, in some states, there are currently no protections for the unborn. These states not only allow abortion on demand - up to the moment of birth - but are actively encouraging women to travel to their state to receive taxpayer-funded abortions.

Since Democrats have already voted at the federal level for their radical bill to allow abortions up to the moment of birth and have threatened to eliminate the filibuster to do so again in the future, I believe it is appropriate for the pro-life community to have minimum protections for life at the federal level in response to the Democrats' position.

I am proud this bill is supported by numerous pro-life organizations like National Right to Life, Susan B. Anthony Pro-Life America, March for Life, Family Research Council, Concerned Women for America, and many others. On the same day the Senate bill was introduced, Representative Chris Smith (R-NJ) introduced a companion bill that already has 85 House Republicans in support.

In Maryland, a new "all-trimester" abortion facility is set to open that will perform abortions as late as 34 weeks. While shocking to the conscience, Maryland is not alone. Other states, including California, New York, Illinois, and Oregon are following similar paths. Unborn children will be dismembered. They will be tragically subjected to a cruel and inhumane death as these states allow abortion until the moment of birth. We as a nation are better than that.

The pro-life community should not stand by or stand down. We must speak up and speak out when states adopt inhumane standards on protecting life. We firmly reject the idea of legitimizing the cruelty of the North Korean and Chinese standard of abortion in America.

There is never a bad time to stand up for the unborn, and that's exactly what I'm doing with this legislation.

Sincerely,

[](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60800032:WLpA4chN1:m:1:877327319:4857F374FE86AA73D7559098BCAB4A2C:r)

Lindsey Graham
United States Senator

| [](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60800033:WLpA4chN1:m:1:877327319:4857F374FE86AA73D7559098BCAB4A2C:r) | [](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60800034:WLpA4chN1:m:1:877327319:4857F374FE86AA73D7559098BCAB4A2C:r) | [](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60800035:WLpA4chN1:m:1:877327319:4857F374FE86AA73D7559098BCAB4A2C:r) | [](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60800036:WLpA4chN1:m:1:877327319:4857F374FE86AA73D7559098BCAB4A2C:r)

Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220920&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220920&amount=28]
Team,
Well, it’s official: you can't turn on a TV in Michigan’s new 7th district without seeing an attack ad against Elissa.
The super PAC ads are up in full force. Republican super PACs, like the National Republican Congressional Committee and the Congressional Leadership Fund, have already spent nearly $3 million in attack ads against Elissa -- the most of any House race in America right now. And they have reservations for an additional whopping $3 million on TV (and digital) ads in Elissa’s district.
This is the GOP playbook lately: keep quiet, don’t do interviews, and just wait for the last 8 weeks of the campaign and hope the GOP super PACs blast her with attack ads that sink in with voters. We’re seeing it across Michigan, and certainly with Elissa’s opponent.
And some of these attack ads are really grasping at straws. In one, an answer Elissa gave during a bipartisan event at U of M is clipped to make it sound like Elissa is making the exact opposite point. Another takes a video clip of a public service announcement about cyber attacks and does what attack ads do best: slow down the footage, put a dark filter over it, and add scary music to the background to indicate something bad is happening.
To make things even more clear: Elissa’s opponent has barely any of his own ads running at the moment. He has decided to let these outside groups do the vast majority of the talking for him.
Elissa’s opponent can hide behind out-of-state super PACs all he wants, but the fact of the matter is that Elissa’s bipartisan work on behalf of the people of mid-Michigan speaks for itself. Chip in before our September 30th end-of-quarter deadline to help us convey that contrast (through ads of our own!) throughout the new 7th district. | Stockton, CA – Today, the Stanislaus County Farm Bureau announced their endorsement of San Joaquin County Supervisor Tom Patti for Congress in the Ninth District.

“The diversity and complexity of the 9th Congressional District makes it unique. Tom Patti has a vested local understanding of agriculture and the importance of every farmer, rancher and farmworker in our local communities. The Stanislaus County Farm Bureau proudly endorses Tom Patti for Congress in District 9,” Farm Bureau leadership said.

“I would like to thank the Stanislaus County Farm Bureau for their endorsement and support for our local farmers in the Central Valley,” said Supervisor Patti. “The agriculture industry is incredibly important in this region and creates thousands of local jobs. Unfortunately, farmers and ranchers have been heavily impacted by record inflation, rising prices, and water supply issues. In Congress I will be a leader for our local agriculture industry and fight for the resources and support they need to thrive. We must rein in reckless spending in Washington and get our economy back on track before family farms are run out of business.”

Tom Patti has also been endorsed by the Lodi Chamber of Commerce, Supervisor Robert Rickman, Supervisor Miguel Villapudua, the San Joaquin Deputy Sheriffs Association, the Stockton Police Officers Association and the Stockton Professional Firefighters Local 456. | | **About Supervisor Tom Patti:** Tom was raised in San Joaquin County and has run a successful local business for decades. He was elected to the San Joaquin County Board of Supervisors in 2016 by an overwhelming margin.

As a County Supervisor, community volunteer, and parent, Tom has worked and dedicated his efforts to safer neighborhoods, demanded real action to reduce homelessness, and advocated for improving the quality, accessibility, and availability of local healthcare.

Tom Patti has worked hard to support veterans, improve and fund our community colleges, support our farmers, advanced workforce equity and created many new job opportunities.

This week is the anniversary of the day my son got blown up while kicking terrorist ass in Afghanistan – a day that our family
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z8vsvkdf90k1jtfmemtr0na26aq41kkec8f19ur8_rp22sh2s8i66or6cdie1or2cph238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq8ddl69qbcd1jmgr32t5nmepradrmeej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hfcppk6uon4cb7mqpj2cb0ehie4p1mcdgj6t35csq7fc9nc9j3dcpkcdgrccjhcurt4s3icgr31cj6e9q32tj0s2q6ac70mkom9pj6cooj5cr3c1rm0pjh62pmcdtgmlin49fg)

---
| | Friend,
---
| This week is the anniversary of the day my son got blown up while kicking terrorist ass in Afghanistan - a day that our family has referred to as his “Alive Day.”

Now, he’s running for Congress to kick Nancy Pelosi’s butt and take on the radical left, but in order to do that, he needs your support. In a minute, I’m going to ask you to [make a small donation to help him win](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zpk3renvhcfafieo5qlf9a8r2ij54a5v7i3bu4oo_rp22sh2s8i66or6cdie1or2cph2bs), but first, let me explain why this is so important...
---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z2576f3qmfmb5ap3a9ocl9mef6t43511c6339r28_rp22sh2s8i66or6cdie1or2cph2bs)
---
| I remember the day Brian’s sister called me 12 years ago to deliver the news. My heart sank - I worried that his newborn son was about to be growing up without a father. I worried that I would never be able to tell my own son the words “I love you” ever again.

Thankfully, my worst fears didn’t come true - Brian survived losing two legs and a part of his hand in that horrific explosion. When I got to the hospital, I made sure that the very first thing I told Brian was that I loved him.

But quickly, that became tough love. I told my son that he had to find a way to bounce back. He couldn’t leave all of his service to his nation behind him.

And even more importantly - he couldn’t let his kids see him feeling sorry for himself.

Boy did Brian take that to heart. Over the years, I watched him recover from his injuries, learn to walk again, graduate college and continue his service fighting his ass off once again for our country as Republican representative for the state of Florida. I’m a proud father.

This year though, my son’s mission to continue that service is different than years past.

That’s because he’s focused on an important task this Election Year - getting accountability for failures in the same military operation where he lost his legs.

You see, Joe Biden is a complete coward, and he turned his back on Brian (not to mention all of the other veterans who served nobly alongside him) when he abandoned the mission in Afghanistan.

So, my son is doing what he does best: fighting back and looking to get accountability for Joe Biden’s failure. Troops were killed and allies were abandoned, and Brian is on a mission to ensure that all who were in charge of this disaster are held responsible.

But in order to do so, he first needs to win his election and help other Republicans take back the majority in Congress.

That takes resources - and I really hope that Brian doesn’t have to focus on raising money of all things during such an important personal time for him.

So I want to ask - as a kind gesture for Brian’s Alive Day and to help him in his mission to get accountability for Afghanistan... [_Will you pitch in to support my son’s campaign today?_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zvl5r34nel2s9hagogpbic0dc8gkfeatap0q7dvg_rp22sh2s8i66or6cdie1or2cph2bs)

His team told me he still needs to raise another _$50,000_ this month in order to hit their goals at this stage in the Election Year.
---
| [PLEASE, DONATE TO HELP MY SON BRIAN](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z0tb4kr5qochehgvn2e64u1c4bct4a07gv5fkf90_rp22sh2s8i66or6cdie1or2cph2bs "PLEASE, DONATE TO HELP MY SON BRIAN")
---
| I appreciate this support, and I know Brian does as well. Thank you for coming together to have his back.

Sincerely,
_Jim Mast_

clean_body: Let’s elect North Carolina’s first Black woman Senator | | | Peter, Cheri Beasley could flip a Senate seat in North Carolina this November. Beasley is no stranger to impressive feats: she was the first Black woman to serve as Chief Justice on the North Carolina Supreme Court, and in May she won her Democratic primary. If Beasley wins her congressional race this fall, she would be just the third Black woman to ever serve in the U.S. Senate – and the first from the South. However, polls are currently showing Beasley is tied with her Republican opponent. While many are focused on races in states like Pennsylvania and Georgia, ensuring a victory in North Carolina could mean the difference between a Democratic or Republican-controlled Senate – or getting the extra two seats we need to make Joe Manchin and Kyrsten Sinema irrelevant. We need to secure every Democratic seat possible this election cycle to bypass Manchin and Sinema’s obstruction, grow our majority by two and save our Senate. Not an easy task – but achievable! **While some politicians in Washington are trying to take away women’s access to reproductive health care, I’m working to protect women's autonomy and ensure that all women — no matter where they live — have the ability to make decisions about their families and their futures.** I introduced the _Reproductive Freedom for All Act_ to do just that. Our bipartisan bill protects women’s ability to make personal health care decisions by codifying the core protections of _Roe v. Wade_ , protecting access to contraceptives, and prohibiting state laws that restrict women's access to care. The support we’ve received from families in Arizona and across the country since we introduced our bill represents a broad coalition of folks standing up in support of women’s autonomy. Now, we need to keep working to ensure we have the resources to continue building support for this bill, so I’m personally asking: [**Friend, if you support the _Reproductive Freedom For All Act_ , please add a donation of $10 or more to help advance this critical legislation. subject: It’s up to us to stop their abortion bans

body:
Believe me when I say: this GOP abortion ban is a worst case scenario.
#
Derek,
**I grew up in a country where abortion was illegal.**
It was *illegal* but still one of the top five leading causes of maternal deaths.
So please, know that when I say the national abortion ban the GOP introduced in Congress last week is a worst case scenario, _I really mean it._
Abortion is an essential component of health care. And just like all other forms of health care, abortion services must be safe, legal and accessible.
**I believe this to my very core, Derek** -- so much so that I have volunteered as a clinic guide to help get abortion patients into the clinic safely, and distract them from the protestors who yell at patients and clinic staff.
No one should be shouted at for making the best choice for themselves and accessing the health care they need, just like no one should have health care access threatened or taken away.
And just like so many volunteers, advocates, and health care workers who show up day in and day out to provide that care, we need to do all we can to fight to defend and expand abortion access.
**One of the best ways to join that fight is by making your first ever donation to John’s campaign.**
He will _always_ put the fights of the people first, including the fight for the right to a abortion. He hasn’t had to evolve or flip-flop on the issues. His views when he first ran for this seat in 2016 are the same ones he has today.
And you can guarantee that if he were in the Senate today, he would be an proud and absolute NO on any type of abortion ban.
**[Derek, if you can, please consider making a donation towards John’s campaign today. As the 51st Democratic vote in the U.S. Senate, he will help abolish the filibuster once and for all, so we can codify Roe, pass crucial voting rights, and more.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220920-1?amount=5&refcode=em20220920-7322&refcode2=7322_434096_NHtQ8X&akid=7322%2E434096%2ENHtQ8X)**

Thank you so, so much for everything.
❤️❤️❤️ Gisele
Gisele Barreto Fetterman
Second Lady of Pennsylvania (SLoP)

There are so many issues on the ballot this year that will determine the future direction of our country, which is why it is so critical that your voice is heard and your vote is counted. If we want a future that promotes rather than constrains our Northwest Washington values – the opportunity to join a union, reproductive freedom, the ability to fight climate change, freedom from gun violence, free and fair elections – then we all must show up and vote this November. subject: Why I’m asking you to support my colleague Andy Kim
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Andy Kim for Congress
body:
My name is Hakeem Jeffries. I'm Andy Kim's neighbor to the north in Congress. I represent New York's 8th District.

It's true that New Yorkers and New Jerseyans have always had a friendly rivalry – it's part of our DNA, I think. But it's also true that we have each other's backs. We're neighbors, after all!

That's why I'm writing to you today. Andy has a tough race this year – Republican leadership and a self-funding opponent are going all-out to defeat him. We can't afford to lose his principled leadership in the House.

Will you chip in $3 and help send my friend and colleague Andy Kim back to the House so we can keep fighting for New Jersey families together? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/stand-with-andy-kim?refcode=2022-09-20-jefferies&recurring=0&amount=3&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=42b6e2bb-2039-ed11-a27c-281878b83d8a]

At a time when politics can feel like a race-to-the-bottom parade of mudslinging and grandstanding, Andy's a steadfast example of decency, humility, and service. Time and again, he's shown us all what leadership and compassion really is.

The current Republican Party has been taken over by MAGA extremists who push our rights and freedoms aside. We can't let extremist Republicans take control of the House of Representatives.

Friend, I need to be extremely upfront with you about where the fight for reproductive justice stands.
The U.S. Supreme Court's overturning of _Roe v. Wade_ is a sickening triumph that Republican extremists worked toward achieving for decades. From passing laws to curb bodily autonomy in GOP-controlled states to electing Donald Trump and confirming his anti-abortion justices to the Supreme Court, Republicans have _long_ sought a complete removal of a woman's freedom to control her own body.
The reversal of _Roe v. Wade_ was not the _end_ of their radical, anti-women agenda, however. It was the moment that the floodgates were opened. Now, they are gearing up for a national ban on abortion. Legislation was already drawn up in the House of Representatives, and just last week, Lindsey Graham introduced an abortion ban in the Senate.
**The most surefire way to stop them from succeeding is by protecting Democratic control of Congress.**
**The best way to _guarantee_ reproductive freedom everywhere is to protect and expand Senate control - and to pass legislation that would enshrine the Roe standard into federal law.**
**[So, at this urgent moment for our nation, I'm humbly asking you to donate $5 - or whatever you can spare - to help me protect this must-win Senate seat. Mitch McConnell's campaign committee is already targeting me, and I'm up against an opponent handpicked by Donald Trump - so I'd appreciate anything you can pitch in right now.](https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/blumenthal-email?refcode=jtk1255-fr-nd&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500)**
In the Senate, I introduced the Women's Health Protection Act, which would enshrine Roe's now-overturned precedent into federal law - and protect the right to an abortion no matter what any right-wing judges or lawmakers say and do.
Unfortunately, Mitch McConnell and all of the Republican Senators blocked this law from advancing, and by doing so, they ensured that Republicans maintain their control over a women's bodily autonomy in _dozens_ of states that put abortion restrictions and bans into effect.
**It 's long past time we abolish the filibuster to protect reproductive freedom, but we simply cannot accomplish that without expanding Democratic control of the Senate. With national Republicans sitting on millions to attack Democrats like me and flip seats from blue to red, I urgently need this grassroots team to join me in fighting back and protecting this seat.**
**[Please, donate $5 or more to help me continue fighting for our reproductive freedom. Whatever you can donate will help protect this crucial seat and ensure control of the Senate remains with Democrats.](https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/blumenthal-email?refcode=jtk1255-fr-nd&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500)**
Thank you,
Dick

Peter,

After our liberal Democrat opponent won his primary, he pulled in more than $1 million from Left-wing donors in just the first 24 hours.

This includes a $100,000 pledge from radical Leftist California Governor Gavin Newsom — who boasts he wants to make “DeSantis a one-term governor.”

So, what kind of “leader” are national Democrat elites like Gavin Newsom trying to put in the Governor’s office?

If it’s Charlie Crist, they’re getting a politician who calls disastrous President Joe Biden “a good man, he’s a great man, he’s a great president,” who accuses Governor DeSantis’s conservative supporters as having “hate” in their hearts, and who promises a Leftist agenda that will make Florida — as Governor DeSantis accurately put it — “a subsidiary of the Biden regime.”

Peter, you know that we can’t let that happen.

With less than 50 days until Election Day, the Left is pulling out all the stops to defeat Governor DeSantis.

Will you step up right now and offer your indispensable grassroots support of this effort

name: Assemblymember Mia Bonta
subject: Ballots will soon land in mailboxes - Let me tell you what I have been doing
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Mia Bonta for Assembly 2022, FPPC# 1437973
body:
Ballots will soon land in mailboxes - Let me tell you what I have been doing since you elected me!| | | Dear Peter, It is hard to believe that just over one year ago you elected me to represent the 18th Assembly District. Since being sworn into office, my team and I have been working hard on behalf of all our District's residents and all Californians to see that there is an equal playing field and opportunities for all of us! In particular, I have been a champion to see that we: • _**Protect access to reproductive care**_ by working with colleagues to invest $200 million in improving security at abortion care providers, improving access to health care providers and increasing access to abortion care. • _**Invest in the future of our children**_ by securing historic funding to K-12, increasing pay rates to childcare providers and expanding eligibility for transitional kindergarten.

• Focus on _**reducing homelessness**_ and improve opportunities for
home ownership.
• Secure millions of dollars to _**improve parks in the 18th AD, help retain Oakland teachers, and provide mental health care in crisis.**_ I am proud of every single vote that I took to policy committee and on the floor. I authored a very aggressive legislative package, and as you read this message, the Governor has acted on 3 of my bills. He has 9 more on his desk, and he has until the end of the month to take action. So, **now I am asking for your help once again, so I may continue doing this work of passion.** Ballots will land in mailboxes soon, and we need to let voters know that I am on the ballot. Will you please stand with me again, as I fight for you, your children, your neighbors, and our environment. On September 24th we have a financial reporting deadline, [**would you please contribute $100, $250, $500, more (up to the $4,900 contribution limit)**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51032322/368044768/588030032?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTk0OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzY2VjOWZkZC0yMjM5LWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Lp2gBxhM44Q2VW7nzgfM0fm1SVFRjiAX5mUDrHKOWqE=&emci=5e54b0c1-a438-ed11-a27c-281878b83d8a&emdi=3cec9fdd-2239-ed11-a27c-281878b83d8a&ceid=21906540) to help us send a strong message that we will not stop until we have broken down the barriers that have kept too many without the tools to succeed and from which we all benefit. I will be back in touch soon to share details of a District fundraiser I hope you will attend - but for now, please give what you can - [$100, $250, $500 or more. ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51032323/368044769/588030032?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTk0OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzY2VjOWZkZC0yMjM5LWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Lp2gBxhM44Q2VW7nzgfM0fm1SVFRjiAX5mUDrHKOWqE=&emci=5e54b0c1-a438-ed11-a27c-281878b83d8a&emdi=3cec9fdd-2239-ed11-a27c-281878b83d8a&ceid=21906540) Questions? Please contact Laurie Earp at 510-839-3100 or events@earpevents.com or click through [here](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51032324/368044770/588030032?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTk0OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzY2VjOWZkZC0yMjM5LWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Lp2gBxhM44Q2VW7nzgfM0fm1SVFRjiAX5mUDrHKOWqE=&emci=5e54b0c1-a438-ed11-a27c-281878b83d8a&emdi=3cec9fdd-2239-ed11-a27c-281878b83d8a&ceid=21906540) now to make your contribution. clean_body: Ballots will soon land in mailboxes - Let me tell you what I have been doing since you elected me!| | | Dear Peter, It is hard to believe that just over one year ago you elected me to represent the 18th Assembly District. Since being sworn into office, my team and I have been working hard on behalf of all our District's residents and all Californians to see that there is an equal playing field and opportunities for all of us! In particular, I have been a champion to see that we: • Protect access to reproductive care by working with colleagues to invest $200 million in improving security at abortion care providers, improving access to health care providers and increasing access to abortion care. • Invest in the future of our children by securing historic funding to K-12, increasing pay rates to childcare providers and expanding eligibility for transitional kindergarten. • Focus on reducing homelessness and improve opportunities for home ownership. • Secure millions of dollars to improve parks in the 18th AD, help retain Oakland teachers, and provide mental health care in crisis. I am proud of every single vote that I took to policy committee and on the floor. I authored a very aggressive legislative package, and as you read this message, the Governor has acted on 3 of my bills. He has 9 more on his desk, and he has until the end of the month to take action. So, now I am asking for your help once again, so I may continue doing this work of passion. Ballots will land in mailboxes soon, and we need to let voters know that I am on the ballot. Will you please stand with me again, as I fight for you, your children, your neighbors, and our environment. On September 24th we have a financial reporting deadline, to help us send a strong message that we will not stop until we have broken down the barriers that have kept too many without the tools to succeed and from which we all benefit. I will be back in touch soon to share details of a District fundraiser I hope you will attend - but for now, please give what you can - Questions? Please contact Laurie Earp at 510-839-3100 or events@earpevents.com or click through now to make your contribution. Thank you for all you do! body:
You may not be aware, but Democratic Senator Maggie Hassan won her last Senate race in New Hampshire by just 1,017 votes.
| | |
---
You may not be aware, but Democratic Senator Maggie Hassan won her last Senate race in New Hampshire by just 1,017 votes. That’s all. We’ve always known that keeping this seat in a tough battleground state would be tough, but I’m coming to you now because the recent Republican primary has really shaken up the race.
Just a week ago, we learned that Maggie Hassan will be facing Don Bolduc, an anti-choice extremist who just can’t seem to stop spreading the Big Lie. Bolduc supported legislation that would **jail doctors for performing medically-necessary abortions.** He said he would work to **overturn future election results in 2024 if President Biden wins.**
I don’t think I need to say more than that to convey that Maggie *needs* to beat him. And she’ll need all hands on deck to do that, **[so I've got to ask if you can pitch in a few bucks to help her.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51032958/368045771/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk1678-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmYzkwZjgwMi0yMzM5LWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DKKNCepL2XzBfKe6ZgtvBsXfHsbqREEMw1uYu2XOfnQ=)**

11 years ago, I was shot.
The bullet damaged the left hemisphere of my brain, where the language function sits. Ever since, Aphasia has been a part of my life. When I speak, the words are there. It’s just hard for me to get them out.
**Aphasia makes it harder for me to speak. But I have not lost my voice.**
With a lot of practice I have found new ways to communicate. Through it all, Mark has been my rock. At every step of my journey, he has been there — pushing me, supporting me, making me laugh. And now, it’s my turn to help him.

* **Raise teacher pay:** Start with a $5,000 increase to make Oklahoma teacher pay the most competitive in the region, with a goal to increase compensation to the national average by 2025.
* **Invest in special education teachers:** Pay an additional 7.5% to 10% compensation above standard teacher pay through new training and micro-credentials for teaching children with dyslexia, autism, and profound disabilities.
* **Extend Oklahoma's Promise:** Make sure that children or dependents of Oklahoma public school teachers are eligible by removing the qualifying income limits for educator households.
* **Extend and grow Oklahoma's School Counselor Corps:** Provide support to improve graduation rates and academic outcomes, and ensure critical student support for mental health and wellbeing.
* **Address the rising costs of goods and services:** Increase funding for student transportation services for the first time since the 1980s -- when the cost of a gallon of diesel was $1.39.

subject: Please read even though it's long 🙏
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Marco Rubio for Senate
body:
|
---
| | | Peter,

I'd like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out. I know I've been reaching out more recently, but that's only because we have less than fifty days until the Election and we're falling behind our End of Quarter Goal.

**I hope you know me to be an honest man of integrity, so I thought I 'd take a second to walk you through why I'm running for office and why this deadline means so much.**

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61345944:6VNrF7VNL:m:1:3317145305:AC1FBE888E1AF65B4BE35E7210FA7E3B:r "2")
---
_My parents on their Wedding Day._
This is a photo of my parents on their wedding day. Thankfully, they came to America before the murderous dictator Fidel Castro came to power and turned Cuba to a dangerous socialist wasteland. After my parents saw what he had done to their homeland, they decided to stay put in America and get to work to achieve the American Dream they came to realize.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61345944:6VNrF7VNL:m:1:3317145305:AC1FBE888E1AF65B4BE35E7210FA7E3B:r "1")
---
_My sister, Veronica, our mother, and me at graduation._
Eventually, my sister and I became first generation college graduates, and while we had to take on student loans to do so, we knew the work ethic our parents instilled would help us pay them down once we graduated.

I met my wife Jeanette in college and we got married in 1998. We started our beautiful family of four kids: Amanda, Daniella, Anthony, and Dominick. We eventually adopted two dogs, Winston and Arthur (who I found with my laptop typing some emails to you recently...).

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61345944:6VNrF7VNL:m:1:3317145305:AC1FBE888E1AF65B4BE35E7210FA7E3B:r "3")
---
_My wife, Jeanette, my daughter, Amanda, and me, circa 2000._
All jokes aside, being a father to my wonderful kids is by far my favorite and most important job, and I will never take that for granted.

I first ran for Senate because I saw what Barack Obama and Joe Biden's policies were doing to families like mine. More families were living paycheck to paycheck at the expense of tax-and-spend Democrats. My parents taught me to work if I wanted to make a change, so that's exactly what I did.

My dad never got to see me become a U.S. Senator in the country he immigrated to in order to make a better life for us, but I carry his work ethic and family values with me every day in the Senate to honor him, and now, I'm teaching my kids exactly what he taught me.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61345944:6VNrF7VNL:m:1:3317145305:AC1FBE888E1AF65B4BE35E7210FA7E3B:r "4")
---
_Campaigning for president in 2015 with my beautiful family._
After seeing the dysfunction in Washington firsthand, I decided to run for President so I could bring my passion for America to the White House. My loving family was right by my side, and I couldn't have been more grateful for their support.

I wanted to stop Hillary Clinton at all costs, and eventually, that meant dropping out of the race and working with Donald Trump to win. Throughout his term, we worked on pro-family and pro-veteran bills to make America great and restore the American Dream.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61345944:6VNrF7VNL:m:1:3317145305:AC1FBE888E1AF65B4BE35E7210FA7E3B:r "5")
---
_On the campaign trail in August 2022. _
**This brings me to my main point: I'm running for Senate because I will never stop fighting to restore the American Dream.**
I feel so blessed looking through these photos, and I wanted to share them with you so you can understand where I am coming from.

Reaching these deadlines may seem like a fundraising ploy, but this is real.**If we 're outraised again, that will be a major step back in our fight to restore the American Dream.
****[I hope you'll make a donation today and join this fight before my deadline:](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61345944:6VNrF7VNL:m:1:3317145305:AC1FBE888E1AF65B4BE35E7210FA7E3B:r "I hope you’ll make a donation today and join this fight before my deadline:")**

Thank you so much for taking the time to read this,

Marco Rubio

body:
Dragging us back to 1912?
| | | | |

| |
---
| | | | | Peter, **_A former Special Forces General turned radical right-wing Senate nominee for the GOP from New Hampshire has a plan to end our democracy._** **_Think I'm being hyperbolic? Don Bolduc, a full-on MAGA-Republican fascist, called on Americans to "rejoice" when Roe V. Wade was overturned, and he'd fully ban abortion. As Democratic, pro-choice Senator Maggie Hassan--whom we MUST reelect!---put it at the time:_** “He said he would vote for any anti-choice legislation in the U.S. Senate, and that he would never compromise,” **It's chilling.** [**Can you join Blue Amp Action in giving $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford to Senator Maggie Hassan to protect abortion and voting rights?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tf91b7a94-c204-4db6-b883-b8c12f2398a6/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _But, his position on the U.S. Senate may be even more terrifying. He's quietly, along with right-wing cranks, pushed for the repeal of the 17th Amendment.**The 17th Amendment gave Americans the ability to elect Senators in their states a century ago, because in another period of vast corruption, progressives knew state legislatures--who picked U.S. Senators at the time--were easily bought by big money.**_ So, progressives passed the 17th Amendment. And much like getting rid of Social Security or abortion rights, even talking about repealing the 17th Amendment was a fringe, fever swamp idea for the 20th and early 21st Century. But, now, it's championed by the insane Bolduc, and others. **_It is not hyperbole to say if the 17th Amendment were repealed DEMOCRATS WOULD NEVER AGAIN CONTROL THE U.S. SENATE_. **

John Lewis** , who fought alongside _Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr._ to make sure black Americans could enjoy the same access to the ballot box as white Americans, to today’s **Stacey Abrams,** who created a statewide movement to lift up the voices of minority Americans, Georgia is filled with leaders who exemplify what it means to be part of a democracy.

body:
Too often, politicians and campaigns insult the intelligence of voters with poll-tested talking points trying to win votes and raise a few quick bucks. We’re running a different type of campaign. I respect your intelligence and that’s why I’m sending you this detailed email laying out the reasons MLG has created a crime crisis in New Mexico and explaining how, together, we can win this campaign and turn things around in the state we all love.| | |
---
| | Dear Peter, Too often, politicians and campaigns insult the intelligence of voters with poll-tested talking points trying to win votes and raise a few quick bucks. We’re running a different type of campaign. I respect your intelligence and that’s why I’m sending you this detailed email laying out the reasons MLG has created a crime crisis in New Mexico and explaining how, together, we can win this campaign and turn things around in the state we all love. Please allow me to explain. No one disputes that crime is skyrocketing in New Mexico. We’re setting murder records and everyone has their own crime story. **However, since MLG has been governor, the prison population in New Mexico has been reduced by 20%.** That alone is a damning and indefensible fact that puts to lie any claim MLG can make saying she’s tough on crime. Our crime crisis – and the fact state prisons are being emptied – are related and the direct result of MLG’s leftwing politics. One of the first things MLG did was to put the most liberal politician in Santa Fe in charge of the parole board. The same guy who consistently sided with criminals and against crime victims in the state Senate...the same guy who **voted against** Baby Brianna’s Law...the guy who believes child abusers who kill their victims should be paroled after 12 years is now in charge of parole under MLG. Pennsylvania is no stranger to these two — in 2020 they worked together to try to overturn the results of a free and fair election. When that failed, Doug Mastriano took matters into his own hands and bused people to the Capitol on January 6th. When the police told rioters to stand down, Mastriano crossed their barricades — defying the orders of law enforcement.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51016339/368009556/1144435635?refcode=nw_em_templateheader&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MWNlOWNmNi0wYjM5LWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UQ67KYmCAB2BnPimiS4Bld9jLPLWLkAshEUf_uya4b8=)

Team,
As Election Day gets closer and closer, I want to take a moment to tell you why I’m running for Governor of Ohio, what makes me different from Mike DeWine, and **[why I’m asking for your support in this race.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51016341/368009557/-1756837021?refcode=nw_em_220920_1_t2&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MWNlOWNmNi0wYjM5LWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UQ67KYmCAB2BnPimiS4Bld9jLPLWLkAshEUf_uya4b8=)**
Now this may seem obvious, but I love Ohio. Nothing makes me happier than getting to talk to Ohioans about the issues that matter most to them. That’s why when I was mayor of Dayton, I held “porch tours.”
I love front porches – they signal how neighborhoods should be, just sitting on your porch and allowing people to come talk to you about the things that matter to them. That’s why I went through the neighborhoods of Dayton, meeting with members of the community to stay in touch. Whether they were worried about their rent rising or asking about where they can get affordable health care, any person could come and talk to me about whatever issue or worry they had.
That’s what this campaign is all about – hearing from every person in Ohio. **Your problem is my problem, and I’ll always be available so you can come and talk to me.**
That’s what makes me different from my opponent. Mike DeWine doesn’t care about Ohioans. He has a small group of wealthy, corrupt friends with political agendas and open checkbooks, and he will always put them first.
Meanwhile, I’ll be sitting on my front porch, visiting your local church basement, or inside your neighborhood library, ready to talk to _you_ about how I can build an Ohio that works for and protects _everyone._
I will be there for you when we win this year. **[But I need your help – in the past few weeks, two major polls have shown us virtually tied with Mike DeWine. Please, rush $5 to my campaign right now so I can continue talking to every Ohioan about the things that matter to them.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51016342/368009558/-1756837021?refcode=nw_em_220920_1_t2&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MWNlOWNmNi0wYjM5LWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UQ67KYmCAB2BnPimiS4Bld9jLPLWLkAshEUf_uya4b8=)**

Nan Whaley

name: Defend the Constitution
subject: Survey on an urgent matter
body:
A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. This sponsored message from Defend the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=8bdb6528f8b8406aa698bf1d1453aab8&_e=MPPnhiCeaNbuntgYSXRzL77pcEYzrARBR9c_8ejAqJSPK-AS2IMBMZ9BZKjF8A5JMrCinaqFfDUNcAfNL2Q81wBdz7azgn_RXQH2_ay8DdR158ggJquIlsgWJji0kvv6OJBT6QxTJZYvITShnPyXRsxcCljWMTgFMA1wKSNbbmPH8uvqziPJ9CFyQR2wyv3KWz1StCG9JWIXVVWT7LIhidFGiD4y4xpWaaos3ANcDCL3u9vXvbHq4OoEZI0P9bYDnyfoEdi3PNnECOqT-tLWLzwI7wPBQyXHsxnHjg_sQvD46PuZT5_nTeqSCX13XNEKFuhiTazL9_UkXVA3jvic4W0kQGS-AU_PEN1j3eV6PeA0_sNLmHPkrFMHIAZUyyV5poLNttPcEwZnYSOde1GEcw%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=8bdb6528f8b8406aa698bf1d1453aab8&_e=MPPnhiCeaNbuntgYSXRzL77pcEYzrARBR9c_8ejAqJSPK-AS2IMBMZ9BZKjF8A5JMrCinaqFfDUNcAfNL2Q81wBdz7azgn_RXQH2_ay8DdR158ggJquIlsgWJji0kvv6OJBT6QxTJZYvITShnPyXRsxcCljWMTgFMA1wKSNbbmPH8uvqziPJ9CFyQR2wyv3KWz1StCG9JWIXVVWT7LIhidFGiD4y4xpWaaos3ANcDCIrKOgljHC0Lr1wFPPNzs0tT74d9ZfTd2mVHtTIHuQ06wU2ymjshZRmivGJQdu_hZ8QPVjfnqMlUn06mXmS83buwoOWEaAZ8thQ7vmIzBfO4r-UwKOmLPV0Z0d1SnK1XWqOp6rovWvH5gvwHtQEWvX34wY70VXkWTJwW0e6MU0CPA%3D%3D)** For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale's Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=8bdb6528f8b8406aa698bf1d1453aab8&_e=MPPnhiCeaNbuntgYSXRzL77pcEYzrARBR9c_8ejAqJSPK-AS2IMBMZ9BZKjF8A5JMrCinaqFfDUNcAfNL2Q81wBdz7azgn_RXQH2_ay8DdR158ggJquIlsgWJji0kvv6OJBT6QxTJZYvITShnPyXRsxcCljWMTgFMA1wKSNbbmPH8uvqziPJ9CFyQR2wyv3KWz1StCG9JWIXVVWT7LIhidFGiD4y4xpWaaos3ANcDCICxWWSadFIy0V4trWqVWD1JBYF7OddfbN5S8L9F30ZMm7BbE3sP4nEC9-k_zjrTTu25rYvuQ4CFwMD3Qb4tePoVK9qgQZruFTINfW7wsDmIni3gYACXFaZ43pMqxYp2dVfF7aPnO8uqlsBVGeB4ge0Qwxj6Jig8gKSOnZCFUgX2g%3D%3D)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Friend,

I know you're busy, but I need just a few minutes of your time.

__**[This is why I'm running.](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=98b71ab65a894b4f8d3a2d43c7a97da6&_e=kuMS2g0DWwBy9X4KmTFOg4TGO1r22D8pDIb5KUK8kv3m6ESL17DVz65_vuCAQ9BZc4KutCT9BVwT_eY0vpJaavUJst3u36kECTs0rP5uM_YJopDykz7YK2Yen8EV6UakDRGsnGLxcjYoqHl_2iFnceSsYv1LvjtRpySmEbmyfXlXgtv_jY3h8NincPXGIw6-unRbVXWJ1__j9ZTldP3pi_V_KhKpMJKsVeJF5JFNoAoQn18mPnOZ8lwiX3WdtkgoN8CjNIAW2rjp5GPJ6r6ashs-6EEnupznxVhZT3k_47OLXt6pZ922U_pQifnJxnBcyeg7-eKhXZC82IMmWeB65nbJevd6AW3NZvhg204aEHG1MFXA4oMif_gSEAkdK7kZhN3OcOwP4JqHb3PGAUMZ7A%3D%3D "This is why I’m running.")**__

I grew up on a small farm in Washington.

We didn't have much, but I learned the value of hard work at a young age. I learned _responsibility_. That is something that political elites will never understand.

As a former triage nurse, I have always been passionate about serving others in my community.

However, everything was tested when a suicide bomber in Iraq permanently blinded my husband, Scotty, and I was told his service was over.
_**The suicide bomber may have taken my husband's vision, but he didn 't take away our determination and drive for service over self.**_
That's how I found myself running against a 30-year Democrat incumbent because we deserve better.

With empty grocery shelves and unprecedented crime, I couldn't sit on the sidelines any longer.

_**[This country is worth serving and sacrificing for, but I need YOUR endorsement to continue my fight!](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=98b71ab65a894b4f8d3a2d43c7a97da6&_e=kuMS2g0DWwBy9X4KmTFOg4TGO1r22D8pDIb5KUK8kv3m6ESL17DVz65_vuCAQ9BZc4KutCT9BVwT_eY0vpJaavUJst3u36kECTs0rP5uM_YJopDykz7YK2Yen8EV6UakDRGsnGLxcjYoqHl_2iFnceSsYv1LvjtRpySmEbmyfXlXgtv_jY3h8NincPXGIw6-unRbVXWJ1__j9ZTldP3pi_V_KhKpMJKsVeJF5JFNoAoQn18mPnOZ8lwiX3WdtkgoMFtX17tM6-eM2gv7b9K3f7xk9aKSs5MjarzQvVcZn0yqWyGQMyY3GrS0KedntIxsqbLdxaGp8d5H6hF7aJpkzNRdxyLwEHUTbAO2IdsxpK4Q9DUszDXTrTBnFR1Vfs6DZP6CYTpyMpWrKEscMVdipA%3D%3D "This country is worth serving and sacrificing for, but I need YOUR endorsement to continue my fight!")**_

I'm not asking for money. _Today, all I 'm asking for is your endorsement. _

We're just weeks away from the General Election, and I know the odds are against me.

However, I genuinely believe that America needs to restore its core values. If you think that too, please, _**[endorse me and join our team.](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=98b71ab65a894b4f8d3a2d43c7a97da6&_e=kuMS2g0DWwBy9X4KmTFOg4TGO1r22D8pDIb5KUK8kv3m6ESL17DVz65_vuCAQ9BZc4KutCT9BVwT_eY0vpJaavUJst3u36kECTs0rP5uM_YJopDykz7YK2Yen8EV6UakDRGsnGLxcjYoqHl_2iFnceSsYv1LvjtRpySmEbmyfXlXgtv_jY3h8NincPXGIw6-unRbVXWJ1__j9ZTldP3pi_V_KhKpMJKsVeJF5JFNoAoQn18mPnOZ8lwiX3Wdtkgo1-SJ5waXZxL5eByq4BMdFPo-bWe-m8GM_dqvvjD0F6ps84e0EBwmqhfqf-zby1m5DvK3gwe99z7XDB3wqD9xYw0TNSDU-3qbOL1suvKuUrLyXDxv2A-YqY7nxA1E5WjrmifxaDTMZ1beYSIhdDA_3A%3D%3D "endorse me and join our team.")**_

It would mean the world to me.

Tiffany Smiley

| | | Friend,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

Peter,

**They just keep moving the ball on me; I feel like I can't get a break, and to be honest with you it's exhausting.** The Republican Party big-wigs in D.C. keep hedging their bets and won't commit to sending me help because **they're somehow _still_ not sure that I'm worth the investment. **

Instead of putting money into my race, **they're spending millions on seats we can't win.** But, as a former national guardsman, I know how to play by the rules and take orders; **here is hoping you can help me meet the requirements they've set in order to barnstorm the state with money to help me secure victory.**

**National Republicans want me to raise $100,000 by the end of the quarter (September 30th), and they'll make an investment in my race; if i can't, I'll be on my own till the end.**

With only 11 days to go, we’re still short about $60,000. **[If you’re in a position to give, would you make a generous contribution to my campaign today?](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=49b1497eb5df40d68144fcce031b6ef0&_e=JyaSQxcy4PpedM4A_hEUrZHJSlxPYLOzXqBdR6GcszaSWS4A1m7lT1pJwRxVAKZzDSrNsL4jnELtEAt2Fqzh4xheJPqArWr67eoEOx5ddcXmh6p7qKkVdsA9yCFozmHFfPqeDoUP7fc0zm6M-zo72cN4aEtHDXoZLpgRCA8zOnqKMWTd0wUEbRtKKv_F-h6G09zcbBBL1qDFQ0O2TKJatrjs8uuCXshUIJ25b1X5kCxl9m7K2_B_7IHndtQ0aUhicoEHPHVZ6xxmWhXnu9T94h6eOd2QYsSHQL1WgDbPSFo-aowFyCmsGQQFp9BrXm5_1L_oz98yJmH7PM2wzp3RefNlKG9XsBInpkeK6-J95HauT_We17cEbicL6PS6f4Qz1GMj_I1dSVF-SfdlobHTV8BN_rvr6ifePbTDZoBO2eE%3D)**

| [**GIFT A COUPLE BUCKS** **› › **](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=49b1497eb5df40d68144fcce031b6ef0&_e=JyaSQxcy4PpedM4A_hEUrZHJSlxPYLOzXqBdR6GcszaSWS4A1m7lT1pJwRxVAKZzDSrNsL4jnELtEAt2Fqzh4xheJPqArWr67eoEOx5ddcXmh6p7qKkVdsA9yCFozmHFfPqeDoUP7fc0zm6M-zo72cN4aEtHDXoZLpgRCA8zOnqKMWTd0wUEbRtKKv_F-h6G09zcbBBL1qDFQ0O2TKJatrjs8uuCXshUIJ25b1X5kCxl9m7K2_B_7IHndtQ0aUhicoEHPHVZ6xxmWhXnu9T94iUFLvMO0y3yFczIYegcUDOpEFBflYi5UH0W1DtO5dZkanTW2qoGBOKc60pJwv0aErJ6XZQJind5U2aGJ-6G-yISafTvqwCeD05jxI0y42llFNQadDf2Fs9mTHJPrqiwHhREeYM1OnjCsThzoSoOh3g%3D)

Whether it’s a test or not - I’m not taking any chances. While Oregon’s 4th district has been held by the same career politician since 1986, **it’s ripe for the picking now that he is _finally _retiring__**.

**[If you’re on the fence about donating to my campaign, remember this race has national implications. The outcome of my race could well determine which party controls the House next year.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=49b1497eb5df40d68144fcce031b6ef0&_e=JyaSQxcy4PpedM4A_hEUrZHJSlxPYLOzXqBdR6GcszaSWS4A1m7lT1pJwRxVAKZzDSrNsL4jnELtEAt2Fqzh4xheJPqArWr67eoEOx5ddcXmh6p7qKkVdsA9yCFozmHFfPqeDoUP7fc0zm6M-zo72cN4aEtHDXoZLpgRCA8zOnqKMWTd0wUEbRtKKv_F-h6G09zcbBBL1qDFQ0O2TKJatrjs8uuCXshUIJ25b1X5kCxl9m7K2_B_7IHndtQ0aUhicoEHPHVZ6xxmWhXnu9T94keqBVzFSKK3BfnRkkLwfobbewNzRL1BOakj_UMv3hJmxeN3yintte9W4G9ABMGwcvtQSvhjvRetlVNTYejWUUIhAwum-JSgWcgPtoh7bCJ_zJ6eVHckSfN4L9X9w_toonUM6RcrHK12pc7SAwW73mE%3D)**

My opponent this year is a the protegée of my opponent from 2020, meaning she supports the Green New Deal, and would most certainly join the House Progressive Caucus.

Republicans came within 554 votes in 2016 from flipping OR-4 from BLUE to RED. Please help me finish the job this time around. If I'm able to secure a sizeable investment from Republicans in D.C., I know we can overcome the barriers that kept us from winning this race two years ago.

---

I know that you have a lot of political candidates asking for you to make contributions to their campaign, but I’d like you to ask yourself this: how many races could realistically determine whether or not Nancy Pelosi loses the speaker’s gavel next Congress? **Less than 10**.

Thanks for your consideration, Peter

body:
| [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51018205/368016706/-1334107482?refcode=header-img&&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDg5NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNDVjNDgyMy0xMDM5LWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Ijuy2h6O_IZCRiOyy0ycGlV1YtttBEP5Gk9NpJAUFjE=)

Look, I know your inbox must be full of emails making overly dramatic claims about the looming deadlines campaigns like mine are facing...

_“It’s make or break!”
“We can’t afford to lose!”
“Our opponent is surging impossibly far ahead!”_

name: Nancy Pelosi
subject: Defending Democracy, Expanding Opportunity – Speaker Pelosi’s Grassroots Volunteer Update with Rep. Val Demings on Wednesday, Sept. 21 at 9PM ET / 6PM PT.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Nancy Pelosi for Congress
body:
Dear Friends,

Thank you for your tremendous support of our House Democrats that is making it possible to fight for our freedoms and to continue to deliver for America’s working families. I am thrilled to invite you to join me and my amazing colleague and very special guest, Congresswoman Val Demings of Florida, for our Grassroots Volunteer update TOMORROW: Wednesday, September 21 at 9PM ET / 6PM PT.

Register here:

https://us02web.zoom.us/webinar/register/1016437740912/WN_Dd9Fh0ubRsidv5G7L5GBlw

Congresswoman Val Demings is a lifelong public servant who fights for the safety and well-being of America’s working families. As a former social worker and law enforcement officer, she worked to protect the most vulnerable and made it a habit to break barriers as she rose to become Orlando’s first woman Chief of Police and to represent Florida’s 10th District in Congress.

The daughter of hardworking parents who worked as a janitor and maid, Rep. Demings fights to make the American Dream that she has lived from the Jim Crow South to the halls of the Congress accessible to everyone. Right now, this pro-choice Harley Davidson-riding grandmother is on her way to shattering yet another glass ceiling to become the first Black U.S. Senator from Florida.

In the House, Val continues her service as a guardian of our personal freedoms, community safety, national security, and Democracy on the House Judiciary, Intelligence and Homeland Security Committees. In 2020, she stepped up once again to defend our Constitution by serving as an impeachment manager to hold a lawless president accountable. As Chair of the Homeland Security Subcommittee on Emergency Preparedness, Response, and Recovery, she takes a lead role in helping our communities recover from national emergencies and disasters.

Congresswoman Demings will be sorely missed in the House, but we could not be more thrilled that she will soon represent millions of Floridians who deserve a Senator who cares about them and their future.

As always, thank you to our VIPs – our Volunteers in Policy and Politics – for all that you continue to do to in your communities to ensure that every voter knows the stakes in this election and has the tools to be heard at the ballot box on election day.

If we are not yet in touch on Twitter, please be sure to follow me at https://twitter.com/TeamPelosi [https://twitter.com/TeamPelosi] for the latest on how – together – we will bring home a great Democratic victory to hold our House and Senate majorities this November!

NANCY

Nancy Pelosi is the Speaker of the U.S. House of Representatives.
As the top Democrat in the House, she's fighting to help working families and protect America from the dangerous agenda of Mitch McConnell and Kevin McCarthy.
We know you're getting a lot of emails -- but it's only because what we're facing right now as a country is so important.
Nancy is committed to doing whatever it takes to elect a record-breaking number of Democrats in the next election and beyond. Can we count on your support?

At the heart of any democracy is the right for people to choose their leaders – to be able to go to the ballot box and have a say in how our country will be governed for years to come.

That is why today, I am proud to help our community celebrate National Voter Registration Day, a day where volunteers and community leaders reach out to our neighbors to make sure they are not only registered to vote in November’s elections but have a plan to vote, too.

**_[The best way we can all do our part to participate in today’s festivities is to make sure we are registered and ready to head to the polls on November 8. And at a time when so much is on the ballot this November, those numbers can have a massive impact on the outcome of our 2022 elections.

But it’s not enough to just understand the gap in registrants that we are facing, we also have to acknowledge how we got here.

In the year 2022, people everywhere are still fighting for the right to cast a ballot in our nation’s elections. And to this very day, we still have leaders who are using their power and authority to keep vital voices of our electorate from being heard.

Right here in Texas, our leaders have enacted numerous voter suppression laws in an attempt to hinder our communities from participating in our democracy. We face a lack of vote-by-mail laws, an inability to register to vote online, and long lines at the polls that make it nearly impossible for hardworking Texans to stand in for fear of the impact it will have on their daily jobs. Not to mention, these laws drastically affect communities of color more than any other voting block.

_**Republicans Should Embrace Grace**_ By Bobby Jindal
---
Despite their protests to the contrary, Democrats seem determined to keep Donald Trump at the center of the nation's political stage. From the FBI's raid on Mar-a-Lago to Joe Biden's recent speech at Independence Hall excoriating Trump's followers, if the current administration wanted to ensure Trump is the 2024 Republican nominee, this seems like a good way to do it. As fractured and radical as the Democrats are, they require something or someone else to run against. The raid and speech intensified Republican interest in the midterm elections, but also make things harder for those Republicans wanting to move beyond Trump in 2024. The raid was a bad day for Ron DeSantis, Mike Pence, Larry Hogan, and others with similar ambitions. One anti-Clinton voter said, "God must have a sense of humor. He is going to make me vote for Donald Trump again." Democrats, on the other hand, may consider the Philadelphia speech a master stroke for 2024, as they truly believe Trump is the weakest possible Republican candidate and hope to make him unbeatable within his own party. Trump evokes visceral reactions in both Democrats and Republicans. The GOP will be tempted to make the November election about Trump, and not about Biden, Democrats, or change. For many Republicans, the raid legitimized Trump's charge that victory was stolen from him in 2020. Democrats cannot help attacking Trump out of pure hatred and fear. clean_body: | | | | Republicans Should Embrace Grace By Bobby Jindal Despite their protests to the contrary, Democrats seem determined to keep Donald Trump at the center of the nation's political stage. From the FBI's raid on Mar-a-Lago to Joe Biden's recent speech at Independence Hall excoriating Trump's followers, if the current administration wanted to ensure Trump is the 2024 Republican nominee, this seems like a good way to do it. As fractured and radical as the Democrats are, they require something or someone else to run against. The raid and speech intensified Republican interest in the midterm elections, but also make things harder for those Republicans wanting to move beyond Trump in 2024. The raid was a bad day for Ron DeSantis, Mike Pence, Larry Hogan, and others with similar ambitions. One anti-Clinton voter said, "God must have a sense of humor. He is going to make me vote for Donald Trump again." Democrats, on the other hand, may consider the Philadelphia speech a master stroke for 2024, as they truly believe Trump is the weakest possible Republican candidate and hope to make him unbeatable within his own party. Thank you for your support,

# September 15th Press Conference - Support Our Police
**Ed’s prepared remarks from Thursday’s Press Conference** _Thank you everyone for coming. A special thanks to the active-duty and retired members of the law enforcement community here today. My message to you today is this: We are here to support you.__We want to continue to live in America’s safest state. Violent crime is rising in Maine, and I believe it will get worse as people become desperate this winter. Much of the blame for this rise in crime are the results of the policies pushed by Representative Pingree and her progressive colleagues in Washington.__For those of you that have never served in law enforcement, I ask you to at least take a few ride-alongs with those who protect you. You will see a variety of situations – any of them could change in an instant – and could change or even end someone’s life.__Add to those few hours that you spend next to their shoes, not in them, that they are human. They are wives and husbands and parents, and also someone’s children.__Serving in law enforcement requires a willingness to walk into any situation to help people anytime. I know how hard it is. I work with and train law enforcement here in Maine. We ask a lot of these men and women. They serve us bravely and selflessly.__The few that do step forward to serve and protect deserve great respect. They are kind and caring, and switch to fearless and brave in an instant. The individuals who serve in law enforcement do not ask for help easily. When they do, we must respond with a caring and supportive hand.__Retired FBI Agent and Reserve Police Officer Todd DiFede in May wrote a very well-thought out letter to Congresswoman Pingree asking for just that, help. Not for himself, but for help with the mental health and wellness of the law enforcement community.__Her response, which is available here today, along with Mr. DiFede’s letter, doesn’t address the issue of Officer Wellness at all. Instead, in paragraph two, Pingree lays out what she perceives as the sins of law enforcement, alleging that police officers kill nearly 1,000 people each year, and disproportionately kill people of color.__In her response to Mr. DiFede, Pingree continues, “ we must address the scope and magnitude of the harms caused by police brutality.” She then proceeds to boast about the laws she has supported cutting resources to law enforcement.__Before pivoting to issues unrelated to her constituent’s request for help, Pingree wrote, “I recommend that you reach out to your local representatives to share your thoughts on this issue.”_ _She has no idea what is needed to support the folks that take care of us while we sleep. It doesn’t seem to occur to her to take care of those that take care of us. Her response was clear: “I do not support you; go ask someone else.”_ _Those who serve in law enforcement work hard. They are under equipped, under paid, understaffed, and as is apparent with Pingree’s words, under appreciated.__This disregard for our Police is contagious. It has affected recruiting. It is causing hate and disrespect from the very people they took an oath to protect.__We are here today to tell the men and women in law enforcement that we support you. We will get you the help, training, and the resources you need to take care of us.__At a time when our law enforcement professionals need our support more than ever, the record is painfully clear: Chellie Pingree is bad for law enforcement.__I call on my opponent to take a stand in support of the men and women in blue and support HR 3080, Congressman Don Bacon’s “Back the Blue Act”.__I also call on Representative Pingree to join me in a debate on public safety issues to showcase for voters the wide gap between our two approaches to the critical issues facing the dedicated members of our law enforcement community.__Thank you._
To request a copy of the exchange between Mr. DiFede and Rep. Pingree, please email your request to [info@thelanderforcongress.com](mailto:info@thelanderforcongress.com?subject=Please%20send%20me%20a%20copy%20of%20the%20DiFede%20Letter&body=null).

I work with and train law enforcement here in Maine. We ask a lot of these men and women. They serve us bravely and selflessly.The few that do step forward to serve and protect deserve great respect. They are kind and caring, and switch to fearless and brave in an instant. The individuals who serve in law enforcement do not ask for help easily. When they do, we must respond with a caring and supportive hand.Retired FBI Agent and Reserve Police Officer Todd DiFede in May wrote a very well-thought out letter to Congresswoman Pingree asking for just that, help. Not for himself, but for help with the mental health and wellness of the law enforcement community.Her response, which is available here today, along with Mr. DiFede’s letter, doesn’t address the issue of Officer Wellness at all. Instead, in paragraph two, Pingree lays out what she perceives as the sins of law enforcement, alleging that police officers kill nearly 1,000 people each year, and disproportionately kill people of color.In her response to Mr. DiFede, Pingree continues, “ we must address the scope and magnitude of the harms caused by police brutality.” She then proceeds to boast about the laws she has supported cutting resources to law enforcement.Before pivoting to issues unrelated to her constituent’s request for help, Pingree wrote, “I recommend that you reach out to your local representatives to share your thoughts on this issue.” She has no idea what is needed to support the folks that take care of us while we sleep. It doesn’t seem to occur to her to take care of those that take care of us. Her response was clear: “I do not support you; go ask someone else.” Those who serve in law enforcement work hard. They are under equipped, under paid, understaffed, and as is apparent with Pingree’s words, under appreciated.This disregard for our Police is contagious. It has affected recruiting. It is causing hate and disrespect from the very people they took an oath to protect.We are here today to tell the men and women in law enforcement that we support you. We will get you the help, training, and the resources you need to take care of us.At a time when our law enforcement professionals need our support more than ever, the record is painfully clear: Chellie Pingree is bad for law enforcement.I call on my opponent to take a stand in support of the men and women in blue and support HR 3080, Congressman Don Bacon’s “Back the Blue Act”.I also call on Representative Pingree to join me in a debate on public safety issues to showcase for voters the wide gap between our two approaches to the critical issues facing the dedicated members of our law enforcement community.Thank you. To request a copy of the exchange between Mr. DiFede and Rep. **MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

name: Cliff Schecter, Blue Amp Action
subject: Sign the petition: Don’t let Native American families lose their rights!
body:
No more Native family separation
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| | |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| | | | | Peter, **[Sign the petition: We cannot allow the rights of Native American families to be stripped](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td15ca2b4-19a8-4f94-a643-677d5461d921/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** Tribal sovereignty is at risk and historically racist tactics could be implemented once again in the name of child welfare – tribal rights and the ability to preserve their unique cultural identities, raise their own children and govern themselves now lies in the hands of the Supreme Court. The Indian Child Welfare Act (ICWA), adopted by Congress in 1978, reversed decades of family separation policies involving Native American families, including efforts to remove children for specious and frequently racist reasons. It establishes basic requirements to protect Native American children from continued forced removal from their families, tribes, and tribal culture. Child removal has been a key element in the U.S.'s dark history of tribal genocide. Mass graves discovered at indigenous boarding schools – where children who were forcibly removed from their families were prohibited from speaking their Native American languages and practicing their religions, and were often abused – have once again shined a light on America’s racist attempts of wiping out Native tribes physically or by forced assimilation. ICWA provides safeguards against forcible removal – individually, or en masse – of indigenous children.
---
| | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://default.salsalabs.org/T65109042-ccff-4492-bb6a-33c1ab63aef0/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
|
---
| | | Now, ICWA is [slated to be reviewed](https://default.salsalabs.org/T84504b8d-1a8b-40d3-83bd-c7e4ac1a7b59/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) by the Supreme Court this fall, a Court with a majority that has shown how eager it is to overturn long-standing law and precedent. If the Court overturns it, states would once again be allowed to remove Native children from their families and culture, placing them with non-Native families, while simultaneously depriving tribes of future generations, putting their very existence at risk. The case before the Court arose as right-wing forces called into question the constitutionality of ICWA claiming it is [“racist against whites”](https://default.salsalabs.org/T51d577be-e75b-47b1-951f-1cdb419cc0ca/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9). In fact, removal has been used for more than 140 years to harm Native children and eradicate tribes altogether. Even today, Indian children in Minnesota, for example, are almost [17 times more likely](https://default.salsalabs.org/T84ef28e2-3d9f-4d12-88c2-5bfda44a3cec/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) to be removed from their families and placed in foster care than non-Indian children – demonstrating the absurdity of the right-wing racist argument. Our legal system has repeatedly failed tribal nations in this country. Now, they’re going for the families. That is why we will rise and say NO to these racist attacks! **We support federal laws designed to preserve Native families and respect tribal heritage.** **[Sign the petition: Support the Indian Child Welfare Act, tribal sovereignty, and families!](https://default.salsalabs.org/T1c78989f-e76e-46a3-b2cc-6d9f6881f4a0/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)**

| | **BROWNLEY REFUSES IN-PERSON DEBATE WITH JACOBS
** _Incumbent Julia Brownley gives no reason for her refusal to participate
in live debate with Federal Prosecutor Matt Jacobs
_ **Thousand Oaks, CA -** Matt Jacobs, Federal Prosecutor and nominee for U.S. Congress in California’s 26th District issued the statement below following Julia Brownley’s refusal to debate in person.

_**“Julia Brownley’s refusal to join me on the debate stage is indefensible, undemocratic, and insulting to the voters of our district,”**_ Jacobs said._**“Live debates have always been a vital part of the democratic process in our country. Voters deserve to hear from both candidates in a neutral, nonpartisan forum so that they can decide for themselves who will best serve our community in Congress.**_
_** **_
_**“Brownley’s refusal to join me on the debate stage is a tacit admission that she’s unable to defend her record – a record that includes votes leading directly to 40-year-high inflation, soaring cost of living, the release of violent criminals, and dismal educational outcomes for so many of our children. **_
_** **_
_**“After 30 years in government, Brownley apparently feels that she’s entitled to re-election and no longer accountable to voters. But this office belongs to the people of our community – not to Julia Brownley – and soon the people will have the opportunity to vote for real change.**_
_** **_
_**“I want to thank the many wonderful local organizations that have offered to host debates – including the League of Women Voters, the Acorn Newspapers, and the Greater Conejo Valley Chamber of Commerce. My position remains unchanged: to ensure voters are as well-informed as possible, I will debate Julia Brownley in person at any time and at any place in our district.”**_ **###** **About Matt Jacobs -** Born and raised in Ventura County, Matt Jacobs devoted his career to serving our country and keeping our community safe. As a federal prosecutor, Matt took on our country’s worst enemies – terrorists, child sex traffickers, fentanyl dealers – and won. Now Matt’s running for Congress to get our country back on track by taking on the out-of-touch career politicians, like Julia Brownley, who’ve failed us. _Learn more about Matt here: _[_“Defending the American Dream.”_](https://link.mattjacobsforcongress.com/u/click?_t=efc64eece5bd468cad54456b97abcf7f&_m=e80ab8740d0141a48437c5934b670e9d&_e=gfaoUNbnDnOf7KqXcJsUUhbo2Qq0Py6t15GAl2OXb3Stw5GZuGov39B2CeXi04r8EaUqhekf9AtVVCFL7-B4eZ6DP3V5IlaZoHih5ulVTM6D6wyFKBvl6L5zyxA6ubAMNffLsPsywPyynyZ8kHZlgEujIHWiCvwwCcqauxLMi4Z0m6wbOZQI2DtC33lcGfY347oUy0A_VYWwU5Tqp_VYjLu39ihJv9QvYY6CmFLeyQ8%3D)
