subject: ACTION ALERT: Oregon needs Cleaner, Healthier Homes & Buildings!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Oregon League of Conservation Voters and authorized by Andrea Salinas for Congress
body:
| | | Dear Peter, Later this week, Oregon's lawmakers will meet to discuss state business. As drought and wildfires continue to plague our state, there isn’t a better time for us to be loud, use our voices, and remind them to make justice-centered climate action a statewide priority. The buildings we live in, work in, and send our kids to learn in are an often overlooked major contributor to climate change — in fact, buildings are the **second largest source of greenhouse gas pollution in our state**. What’s more, the majority of Oregon homes and buildings are currently unprepared to protect us from climate change’s ever-worsening effects. [_**We must urge our lawmakers to take action towards Oregon’s transition to clean, healthy, and climate-resilient buildings as swiftly and equitably as possible.**_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/51050051/368094346/869579976?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjMwNzFhMjczLTQ2MzktZWQxMS1hMjdjLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=FCfQbDZjcPkw1jXfjy8aUTSTkWiWcNG-z0jLnRemVss=&emci=d1c43974-3339-ed11-a27c-281878b83d8a&emdi=3071a273-4639-ed11-a27c-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230) Buildings contribute to climate change in a variety of ways, yet among the most pervasive and harmful ways they pollute is through the burning of methane gas – a dangerous fossil fuel that the industry markets as “natural” gas – to power and fuel our homes. Combusting methane in buildings releases toxic chemicals indoors, including carcinogens that drastically increase the risk of debilitating health conditions affecting the heart and lungs, often leading to asthma. A dire consequence of burning methane for our heaters and stoves is that ___children are the most susceptible demographic to suffer from the health impacts of its indoor pollution._ Further, _low income and Black, Indigenous, people of color (BIPOC) communities are at higher-risk of developing adverse health conditions from higher levels of building-sourced fossil fuel pollution_. [_**We need our lawmakers to treat this like the public health and climate crises that they are by asking them to prioritize clean, healthy buildings.**_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/51050052/368094428/869579976?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjMwNzFhMjczLTQ2MzktZWQxMS1hMjdjLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=FCfQbDZjcPkw1jXfjy8aUTSTkWiWcNG-z0jLnRemVss=&emci=d1c43974-3339-ed11-a27c-281878b83d8a&emdi=3071a273-4639-ed11-a27c-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230) It is paramount that our state transitions to use energy-efficient heat pumps to heat and cool our homes and buildings, to build smart from the start with better building standards, and create high quality local jobs upgrading existing buildings to be more efficient, resilient, and healthy. Only positive outcomes can come from making new and existing buildings more energy efficient, durable to climate change, and safer for their inhabitants. The transition will create jobs that cannot be outsourced, lower people’s energy bills, and improve the indoor air quality for thousands of Oregonians. Investing in clean and healthy buildings across our state should be a no-brainer for our lawmakers, so [_**will you send them a message while they’re meeting to let them know that Oregon’s people are calling for safer, healthier, clean-energy-fueled buildings that can endure the changes in our state’s climate?**_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/51050053/368094473/869579976?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjMwNzFhMjczLTQ2MzktZWQxMS1hMjdjLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=FCfQbDZjcPkw1jXfjy8aUTSTkWiWcNG-z0jLnRemVss=&emci=d1c43974-3339-ed11-a27c-281878b83d8a&emdi=3071a273-4639-ed11-a27c-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230) Julia DeGraw

clean_body: | | | Dear Peter, Later this week, Oregon's lawmakers will meet to discuss state business. As drought and wildfires continue to plague our state, there isn’t a better time for us to be loud, use our voices, and remind them to make justice-centered climate action a statewide priority. The buildings we live in, work in, and send our kids to learn in are an often overlooked major contributor to climate change — in fact, buildings are the second largest source of greenhouse gas pollution in our state. What’s more, the majority of Oregon homes and buildings are currently unprepared to protect us from climate change’s ever-worsening effects. Buildings contribute to climate change in a variety of ways, yet among the most pervasive and harmful ways they pollute is through the burning of methane gas – a dangerous fossil fuel that the industry markets as “natural” gas – to power and fuel our homes. Combusting methane in buildings releases toxic chemicals indoors, including carcinogens that drastically increase the risk of debilitating health conditions affecting the heart and lungs, often leading to asthma. A dire consequence of burning methane for our heaters and stoves is that _children are the most susceptible demographic to suffer from the health impacts of its indoor pollution. Further, low income and Black, Indigenous, people of color (BIPOC) communities are at higher-risk of developing adverse health conditions from higher levels of building-sourced fossil fuel pollution. It is paramount that our state transitions to use energy-efficient heat pumps to heat and cool our homes and buildings, to build smart from the start with better building standards, and create high quality local jobs upgrading existing buildings to be more efficient, resilient, and healthy. Only positive outcomes can come from making new and existing buildings more energy efficient, durable to climate change, and safer for their inhabitants. The transition will create jobs that cannot be outsourced, lower people’s energy bills, and improve the indoor air quality for thousands of Oregonians. Investing in clean and healthy buildings across our state should be a no-brainer for our lawmakers, so Julia DeGraw Coalition Director, OLCV | | ---|---|--- | | Connect With Us: | | Contact Info: Oregon League of Conservation Voters 321 SW 4th Ave Ste 600 Portland, OR 97204 United States | ---|--- | If you believe you received this message in error or wish to no longer receive email from us, please. Fellow American,

Thank you for opening this email. I wanted to take a few minutes to share a few moments in my life and my upbringing that have made me who I am today.

[](http://links.georgeloganforcongress.com/u/click?_t=ab154d37b4f04f71ab6ab4c65effe590&_m=827534a38b75411a8a7c60b8a4410599&_e=J7Chy9hG5ubZopwcPuTRfeG7rNTLe9z41MdakGDi9wsnA6O6XmZPd00_Ra1kmn3WJESRl4ZuWx3e3-y7Ne8_tphBMRdJ-5oNM0j2_g5PHFyks6Nk3kWom-1Br7nAdxJ4vY5b4QOgTEJ5sYBaP2AxFRcs2MWE6r87_rISglbD_vABkjCCnjvfF7pVpj1f8fIfZbHgkDjKJw3xR2-Xr2cpPfBKRqQphyv8yC8zBTcXPs4-8nlEVH8Z8ZBOY7OLyKt1gUHw9pL0-zGVKHyxfpblbGcr8GvTAvrG9oE9ovkhm3EMlpS5cGQke2tVceMo7qs8irzed-6kf0vPoDEil3AbmEx25NQ-Gbdcn3NIqDPH3xOqWDe3moP-b6lAi1GU4rdoI8i27i5NayNRjocDwPu6wszMKYLA08b7Vit9l3QjDCY%3D)
This is a photo of my mom and dad. They instilled the very values I live by today, **which is to put your family first, to serve your community, to be as educated as possible, and to always work hard.**

My parents came to this great nation to live out their American dream. They worked day and night at factory jobs and office administrative work to ensure I was getting the education to land a better job so that I could pursue my American dream.

[](http://links.georgeloganforcongress.com/u/click?_t=ab154d37b4f04f71ab6ab4c65effe590&_m=827534a38b75411a8a7c60b8a4410599&_e=J7Chy9hG5ubZopwcPuTRfeG7rNTLe9z41MdakGDi9wsnA6O6XmZPd00_Ra1kmn3WJESRl4ZuWx3e3-y7Ne8_tphBMRdJ-5oNM0j2_g5PHFyks6Nk3kWom-1Br7nAdxJ4vY5b4QOgTEJ5sYBaP2AxFRcs2MWE6r87_rISglbD_vABkjCCnjvfF7pVpj1f8fIfZbHgkDjKJw3xR2-Xr2cpPfBKRqQphyv8yC8zBTcXPs4-8nlEVH8Z8ZBOY7OLyKt1gUHw9pL0-zGVKHyxfpblbKKDTAY0pXYX422hLAN6tye2n0GsWm1aSxk8yZpA3t_aGsS1rYUynt81l6kE9GJqT6NlG7WBIdiFmsT0DjW8CPRlak6IjIAQmCEIC_ruUKXt9eUQ090w4VrQ-eymioN8cO09sNps62a21zqdFCkCy34%3D)
I am a first-generation college graduate, and I even earned my master’s degree. I had to take out a good amount of student loans, but as my parents taught me, my hard work would pay off.

I soon met my wife, Lisa, and we fell in love. She has always been my rock. She supported me by working as a nurse with the State Department of Mental Health and Addiction Services so **that I could open my own business and continue my American Dream.**

[](http://links.georgeloganforcongress.com/u/click?_t=ab154d37b4f04f71ab6ab4c65effe590&_m=827534a38b75411a8a7c60b8a4410599&_e=J7Chy9hG5ubZopwcPuTRfeG7rNTLe9z41MdakGDi9wsnA6O6XmZPd00_Ra1kmn3WJESRl4ZuWx3e3-y7Ne8_tphBMRdJ-5oNM0j2_g5PHFyks6Nk3kWom-1Br7nAdxJ4vY5b4QOgTEJ5sYBaP2AxFRcs2MWE6r87_rISglbD_vABkjCCnjvfF7pVpj1f8fIfZbHgkDjKJw3xR2-Xr2cpPfBKRqQphyv8yC8zBTcXPs4-8nlEVH8Z8ZBOY7OLyKt1gUHw9pL0-zGVKHyxfpblbHSlEWcp7NvyJQaMntiHYvZuoD5OzDBEqCYcBPbBx3OuYGMdChjbb3lOkm9zj-Lu5xF0dAGB3-CSeqxZYtjFS_SQ-aZjSCk4_8jeYgM2I-przIhFAi-qcCwiAQLxOKRkcBOA61k-N4RknK1lmSijURc%3D)
Since then, we have had two amazing children - our oldest is a college graduate, and our youngest is enrolled. Lisa and I could not be prouder. But my goal is to continue making them proud of me; **my job as their role model is not done yet.**

I want them to see that no matter who you are and what your background is, you can achieve great things with hard work and dedication while still being able to serve the greater good and even future generations. **That is why I am running for Congress.**

[](http://links.georgeloganforcongress.com/u/click?_t=ab154d37b4f04f71ab6ab4c65effe590&_m=827534a38b75411a8a7c60b8a4410599&_e=J7Chy9hG5ubZopwcPuTRfeG7rNTLe9z41MdakGDi9wsnA6O6XmZPd00_Ra1kmn3WJESRl4ZuWx3e3-y7Ne8_tphBMRdJ-5oNM0j2_g5PHFyks6Nk3kWom-1Br7nAdxJ4vY5b4QOgTEJ5sYBaP2AxFRcs2MWE6r87_rISglbD_vABkjCCnjvfF7pVpj1f8fIfZbHgkDjKJw3xR2-Xr2cpPfBKRqQphyv8yC8zBTcXPs4-8nlEVH8Z8ZBOY7OLyKt1gUHw9pL0-zGVKHyxfpblbNm2O7lEG3NBYWtT1ztBR9PFoxNMhXf4HllLnoZ5pIhpdx-owOtJb_ixGQ4wTIlO2rNmv99nrxGdMyfNC6uy-2pMkcrhCcsdDubhoZQILsu1jfONczvJR3jDv9V4re5ci2UcGrF4IN5bKJqyhJucuZk%3D)
I have seen the mess that Nancy Pelosi and Joe Biden’s policies have brought upon our nation, and I have seen firsthand the struggles it has placed on my community. **I can’t stand the fact that this is the environment our children have to start their lives in.**

Our country has lost sight of our founding principles due to poor leadership and a lack of patriotism, and I’m ready to do something about it.

Hello,
My mother worked alongside my dad in Lebanon Farm Shop well into their 70s. They refused assistance from their many children even after they lost their life savings in the Savings and Loan debacle of the 1980s. My mom in coveralls, petite as she was, handing tools to my dad is an indelible image I carry with me to this day.
My dad built a business repairing farm implements. In a way, I think he hoped that I’d stick around and take it over, but that wasn’t to be. I joined the Navy after getting a scholarship and my life as a machinist and welder came to a close.
Dad said very little about his service in the Second World War. He had the burns and shrapnel of his first ship sinking, and would provide some quips about surviving a night amongst the flotsam and death off Guadalcanal, but he didn’t dissuade me from enlisting. My mom had the bravery in saying quite simply, “The healthy bird flees the nest.” She wiped her eyes on her apron as I drove up the hill on my way to ‘boot camp.’ It took me some time to understand why.

Can I count on you to split a $10 donation between my campaign and the DNC to flip North Carolina and elect Democrats nationwide to expand our Senate majority?****

Peter,

As we get closer to Election Day, we know that you’re probably getting
several emails a day from different candidates and organizations. But let
us take a moment to explain why you should chip in to JD in response to
this email today.

Revenue from our email program is a major source for funding our work.

55% of everything we raised last month came in through our email program.
As a grassroots organization, we truly rely on supporters like you
chipping in $5, $15, or even $50 at a time — we don’t take a dime from
corporate PAC funders.

There are real people writing these emails and we’ll never resort to DCCC
style, the-sky-is-falling tactics to try and scare you into contributing.
But we will politely ask if you’ll make a contribution to help us continue
to recruit and support candidates who will fight for our values.

Our goal this month is to raise $125,000 to continue our work to transform
the Democratic Party by electing more transformative candidates like
Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, Jamaal Bowman, and Cori Bush.

values and works for the voters?

Thank you so much for your support. Our work is only possible because of

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Peter,

**Today is National Voter Registration Day**. Before I began running for office, I would have had no clue the significance of September 20th on the calendar.

Major political handicappers consider the congressional district I’m running in just slightly more Democrat than Republican, meaning It’s no more likely to vote Democrat than it is Republican. Depending on the climate of the general electorate -- and the candidate -- the district could send a socialist to Congress or a Republican.

It’s clear that I’m not going to win over any Democrat voters at this point in time. subject: Fixing College Debt
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Max Steiner for Congress 2485 Notre Dame Blvd, Ste 370 #194 Chico, CA 95928
body:

---
Hi friend,

Today I'm going to talk about college debt. To set the stage, it's important to understand the scale of the problem: $1.75 trillion dollars in debt, spread over 48 million borrowers. Thats about 1/15 the size of the national debt ($26 trillion), and 50% more than all auto debt in the US (about $1 trillion). In terms of numbers, 1/6 Americans over 18 have college debt. So it's a big deal. How do we fix it? Not by debt forgiveness. I'm not opposed to Biden's $10k/$20k forgiveness plan, but it's really important to understand that program was a Band-Aid. The real problem is three-fold: **1) The cost of university has skyrocketed over the past 59 years.** It's time for the government to crack down on private AND public universities with high administrative costs and "vanity projects." Student fees should be paying for faculty (professors) and facilities. It's time for the federal government to take a more active role in controlling costs, rather than just adding more money to the problem. **2) Student loans currently assign the risk to the borrower rather than the lender.** Unlike every other type of loan, student loans cannot be discharged in bankruptcy. It doesn't make sense - and it feels morally repugnant - to force an 18-year-old to make such a life-altering economic choice - that the can never take back. Though it was lost in the talk about debt forgiveness, there is a solution here: the Biden administration is proposing a series of rule changes that would make loans much fairer for students. Read more here, under Part 3. It's great. (https://studentaid.gov/debt-relief-announcement/) **3) Too many students are going to college rather than pursuing vocational degrees or working in the trades.** The single focus on 4-year colleges over the past 30 years has been a mistake. There are certain policy changes we can make, such as expanding Federal Student Loans and Pell Grants to vocational schools is a good start. However, this will also take a cultural change: not going to college doesn't make you a failure. I was guilty of this: I judged my brother for dropping out of UC Davis as a physics major to become a car mechanic, but he makes good money and he likes his job. This is a long email, but it's also a complicated topic. It's important for politicians to put real thought into policy, rather than just make nice-sounding statements that never gets to the root of the problem. **Doug LaMalfa has no interest in solving college debt. Instead, he tried to stoke class warfare when Biden's Debt Relief Plan was announced: claiming that "blue collar workers" were going to pay for useless degrees. It was pretty ironic coming from a heavily subsidized rice farmer.** But then again, Doug tried to overturn the 2020 election based on conspiracy theories. _Maybe he should have paid more attention in college himself._ If you support sensible student debt reforms (and democracy), please support my campaign. Vote. Talk to your neighbors. Donate. Thanks for all the support so far,

Max

---

**CHASKA, MN** – Dr. Scott Jensen (R-Chaska), Minnesota gubernatorial candidate, released the following statement after President Biden-appointed United States District Attorney Andrew Luger announced indictments of 47 individuals associated with $250 million in federal COVID food aid under Governor Tim Walz's (DFL-St. Paul) watch. The dollars were designated exclusively for Minnesota students and families to feed them during the pandemic while schools were shut down by Walz.

**“While Governor Walz shut down schools during the pandemic, the federal government gave us a lifeline in additional federal aid to feed children and families who needed meals during that trying time,” **said Dr. Jensen, a Minnesota Family Doctor of the Year.** ****“However, under Governor Walz, a quarter billion dollars were stolen from their mouths by an Education Department and Walz-appointed commissioner who failed to do their jobs and prevent fraudulent activity from occurring in the first place. [As outlined by a comprehensive Minnesota Senate Education Committee report](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=ffe8f95452&e=33b11688c1), Walz’s education department and commissioner failed to establish accountable business practices, broke state and federal law, and still to this day refuse to admit that they did anything wrong. In fact, the CFO for the Minnesota Department of Education claimed during a legislative hearing that their [“policies and procedures worked.”](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=76e8596a31&e=33b11688c1) Obviously, that’s a barefaced lie. Every Minnesotan can see that accountability is desperately needed, and while I will bring that when elected on November 8th, Tim Walz owes every citizen of our state the courtesy of asking for his education commissioner to resign.”**

Governor Walz appointed Heather Mueller, Ed. D. to the position of Minnesota Education Commissioner in 2021 after his previous commissioner, Mary Cathryn Ricker, resigned to spend more time in the classroom. Commissioner [Mueller started her career and served as an administrator in the Mankato Area Public Schools](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=216ef11852&e=33b11688c1), the [same district in which Governor Walz and his wife worked in](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=8752228145&e=33b11688c1), with their tenures overlapping.** ** According to United States Attorney Andrew Luger, the $250 million in fraud under Commissioner Mueller and Governor Walz is [“the largest pandemic fraud in the country, and the charges amount to one of the largest federal fraud cases ever brought in Minnesota.”](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=a6a2290703&e=33b11688c1)
**“Under the watch of Governor Walz and Commissioner Mueller, the largest case of pandemic fraud in the country occurred,” **concluded Dr. Jensen. **“Today, the United States Attorney General’s office is making clear what we already know: fraud is widespread in Minnesota under the lack of leadership exhibited by Tim Walz. It’s time he finally leads and asks for the resignation of Commissioner Mueller.”** **###**

Believe it or not, we are just 7 weeks out from Election Day! We’ve compiled a list of 7 things you can do right now to help us in these final days.
#1. Call 7 neighbors.
Word of mouth is one of the best ways to get the word out about the importance of this election. Pick up the phone right now and call 7 neighbors, friends, or family members about why voting in November is so important and get them to commit to vote.
#2. Knock on 7 doors.
Don’t miss your chance to help rally voters to the polls for important races up and down the ballot. We need as much help as we can get so please mark your calendar now for our next big Day of Action, Saturday, October 1st!

body:
We're less than 50 days away from the midterm elections! | | | |
---
| | |
---
| **National Voter Registration Day Event** We are less than 50 days away from the 2022 midterm elections! Join folks from across the country, like you, that are taking action on National Voter Registration Day. You'll hear from special guest Congresswoman Katie Porter and learn the fundamentals of relational organizing from the DNC's Community Organizing team. By mapping out your relationships, you can make an impact on your community and the upcoming election. Register for the event below.
---
| [Register Here](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=8144c7d796&e=d6c5c7d7ec "Register Here")
---
| To check your voter registration status, your nearest voting locations, or just general information on voting, visit IWillVote.com at the button below!
---
| [IWillVote.com](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=28b9de1392&e=d6c5c7d7ec "IWillVote.com")
---
|
---
|
---
| **Social Ambassador Training** Sign up to join us on National Voter Registration Day, **Tuesday, September 20, 2022 at 9-10 PM ET** for a virtual training! Be in community with fellow Native volunteers across the country who are organizing with Democrats on social media. Expand your organizing toolbox and join our inaugural Social Ambassador program. Be part of organizing across social media platforms to amplify facts, combat disinformation, and be trained on everything from storytelling techniques to the most current messaging priorities for Democrats.
---
| [Sign Up Here](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=b4f79407e9&e=d6c5c7d7ec "Sign Up Here")
---
|
---
| ** The Situation in Puerto Rico**

As Puerto Ricans see unprecedented weather conditions, the President and Democrats are ready to take action:

* [@POTUS: “Today, I spoke with @GovPierluisi to address the immediate needs of Puerto Rico in the wake of Hurricane Fiona.](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=ba2cdfa3f6&e=d6c5c7d7ec) [We discussed federal personnel working to assist the island's recovery, and I assured the Governor that we'll increase support substantially in the coming days.”](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=6d42c9ce20&e=d6c5c7d7ec)

* **[@TheDemocrats: “This week, President @JoeBiden declared an Emergency Disaster Declaration to ensure the full force of federal government support for Puerto Rico in its response efforts to Tropical Storm Fiona.](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=821b959ae2&e=d6c5c7d7ec) ****[We are here in support of all those affected. Together, we’ll get through this.”](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=5b1cd8da18&e=d6c5c7d7ec)**

* **[@HarrisonJaime: “Puerto Rico has been through some very tough storms recently... ready to do what we can to help them get through this one.”](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=893329d2af&e=d6c5c7d7ec)**

---
|
---
|
---
| **HBCU Week**
The White House Initiative on Advancing Educational Equity, Excellence, and Economic Opportunity through Historically Black Colleges and Universities (Initiative) will convene its annual national conference Sept. 20-23 in Washington, D.C. This year’s conference is both a tribute to the monumental contributions of HBCUs to this country, as well as an acknowledgement of the critical role these important institutions play in advancing the nation’s global competitiveness. The conference will coincide with the celebration of National Historically Black Colleges and Universities (HBCU) Week.

The Biden-Harris Administration continues to take a whole-of-government approach to support the well-being of students, families, staff and faculty at HBCU campuses. To date, the Administration has delivered nearly $6 billion in cumulative investments to HBCUs, including:
* $3.7 billion through the American Rescue Plan and other COVID relief;
* $1.6 billion in capital finance debt relief; and
* $500 million in grant funding to help HBCUs and other MSIs expand capacity.

body:
My opponent is a multi-millionaire with hundreds of thousands of dollars from special interests behind his campaign, and that's simply not who I am. | |
---
| | | [ ](https://pennyronning.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05c2d51066158a4f5219d9967&id=de9b954950&e=2f4ec52c5e)
---
| | | Peter Willis,

**Today on** **9/20 I'm asking you to chip in any amount of 9.20 that you can**! My opponent, Matt Rosendale, is a **multi-millionaire with hundreds of thousands of dollars from special interests** behind his campaign, and that's simply not who I am. We want individual contributions from people like you to support our campaign.

This campaign has always been, and will always be, a people-powered grassroots movement to fight for the Montana values we all hold so close to our hearts like hard work, freedom, and hope.
* I'm fighting to lower the price at the pump because Rosendale won't.
* I'm fighting to fix our crumbling roads and bridges because Rosendale won't.
* I'm fighting to lower rising housing costs because Rosendale won't.

However, I can't keep fighting without your help. We need [volunteers](https://pennyronning.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05c2d51066158a4f5219d9967&id=126e07e853&e=2f4ec52c5e) to knock on doors, people to [chip in](https://pennyronning.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05c2d51066158a4f5219d9967&id=4066232cda&e=2f4ec52c5e) to support our efforts, and more.

I know not all folks have time to volunteer so I ask that you give me an hour of your time in a different way.

[__**Montana's minimum wage is $9.20, so to help me keep fighting can I count on you to make a recurring donation of an hour of your time each month or a donation?**__](https://pennyronning.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05c2d51066158a4f5219d9967&id=bd0b207299&e=2f4ec52c5e)

Thank you and together we rise!

Peter,

**They just keep moving the ball on me; I feel like I can't get a break, and to be honest with you it's exhausting.** The Republican Party big-wigs in D.C. keep hedging their bets and won't commit to sending me help because **they're somehow _still_ not sure that I'm worth the investment. **

Instead of putting money into my race, **they're spending millions on seats we can't win.** But, as a former national guardsman, I know how to play by the rules and take orders; **here is hoping you can help me meet the requirements they've set in order to barnstorm the state with money to help me secure victory.**

**National Republicans want me to raise $100,000 by the end of the quarter (September 30th), and they'll make an investment in my race; if i can't, I'll be on my own till the end.**

With only 11 days to go, we’re still short about $60,000. **[If you’re in a position to give, would you make a generous contribution to my campaign today?](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=4c22d4ebd3c94c0cbe25f0f3cf26e96d&_e=xk5m-2QuW0Kb1Yebgkj5iR8MHob5BGbblj_GmD16iw5ROgEsrdz1bjobVaQFZdsPmwapYTs9GiNq8qeeD_1Nnl2YztYsD-p-bcXXurd_DkPHwPftN0xghSipxh4mjgXOXbTt0lvHCmuZaRrXbWR_MUvMsiFbosFbB71z2Xkkkc4n560B3PaRnmXe0XZ1oUYCR1FX3STrrJYzmgN4jv4Pj-mNA-Cy4Y-tLwe3JvTzDk6v5XsMLcF-AM5fZDK1WAWW197iHipVmX4fZOObaqmI4gj80sP6yg8Zgkic-XrxdxXPU9veIHMQlJpAbrvk8RemLbA2u1BCN397rF2tqj0fgxO6qSTJ1rwLboFGm_AUisofQj4kP68yy60uXQIQO6KxXTUj6OvYlxxa8Xpe7uqFvEk_Af37isdkJSqC02UQ9DU%3D)**

| [**GIFT A COUPLE BUCKS** **› › **](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=4c22d4ebd3c94c0cbe25f0f3cf26e96d&_e=xk5m-2QuW0Kb1Yebgkj5iR8MHob5BGbblj_GmD16iw5ROgEsrdz1bjobVaQFZdsPmwapYTs9GiNq8qeeD_1Nnl2YztYsD-p-bcXXurd_DkPHwPftN0xghSipxh4mjgXOXbTt0lvHCmuZaRrXbWR_MUvMsiFbosFbB71z2Xkkkc4n560B3PaRnmXe0XZ1oUYCR1FX3STrrJYzmgN4jv4Pj-mNA-Cy4Y-tLwe3JvTzDk6v5XsMLcF-AM5fZDK1WAWW197iHipVmX4fZOObaqmI4ldWMQKpv4-fx3xX_uDAu6B0Wr4N0JrVzBllvGc0M9BXNL4949IKKnggEBAfg2GzftFnUChRV5RkBaPlhVAzZ3oxFFa3sYFpPosrma9jrAwUw0v2DdDggEi8tyl-Wl0pzkhetVishN61fJxdhbCTItQ%3D)
---

Whether it’s a test or not - I’m not taking any chances. While Oregon’s 4th district has been held by the same career politician since 1986, **it’s ripe for the picking now that he is _finally _retiring__**.

**[If you’re on the fence about donating to my campaign, remember this race has national implications. The outcome of my race could well determine which party controls the House next year.](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=4c22d4ebd3c94c0cbe25f0f3cf26e96d&_e=xk5m-2QuW0Kb1Yebgkj5iR8MHob5BGbblj_GmD16iw5ROgEsrdz1bjobVaQFZdsPmwapYTs9GiNq8qeeD_1Nnl2YztYsD-p-bcXXurd_DkPHwPftN0xghSipxh4mjgXOXbTt0lvHCmuZaRrXbWR_MUvMsiFbosFbB71z2Xkkkc4n560B3PaRnmXe0XZ1oUYCR1FX3STrrJYzmgN4jv4Pj-mNA-Cy4Y-tLwe3JvTzDk6v5XsMLcF-AM5fZDK1WAWW197iHipVmX4fZOObaqmI4qxjMhQ1H_9Ja0Et1Ww8tJwh5qdfcc6PmBmufuf1TgdW2T4YhCSHNUOJKPjELmu9I2iyuknEV5CWGX0A4S7tZ_tfy2UMaV6c0pJpJKFJvFQo7tkS8A8y0mCOreCWhflTwwXgDUQ-i0WfhZ0CXsuDtyc%3D)**

My opponent this year is a the protegée of my opponent from 2020, meaning she supports the Green New Deal, and would most certainly join the House Progressive Caucus.

Republicans came within 554 votes in 2016 from flipping OR-4 from BLUE to RED. Please help me finish the job this time around. If I'm able to secure a sizeable investment from Republicans in D.C., I know we can overcome the barriers that kept us from winning this race two years ago.

[**GIFT A COUPLE BUCKS** **› › **](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=4c22d4ebd3c94c0cbe25f0f3cf26e96d&_e=xk5m-2QuW0Kb1Yebgkj5iR8MHob5BGbblj_GmD16iw5ROgEsrdz1bjobVaQFZdsPmwapYTs9GiNq8qeeD_1Nnl2YztYsD-p-bcXXurd_DkPHwPftN0xghSipxh4mjgXOXbTt0lvHCmuZaRrXbWR_MUvMsiFbosFbB71z2Xkkkc4n560B3PaRnmXe0XZ1oUYCR1FX3STrrJYzmgN4jv4Pj-mNA-Cy4Y-tLwe3JvTzDk6v5XsMLcF-AM5fZDK1WAWW197iHipVmX4fZOObaqmI4n69MbRqDxacNl3nNoiQ-7WX30Tk8MJnA18J9TmUMql17YTH9Hrrnk6j22ZMBpWKi9MZdv4_6YOllfi90QKlvKVOl3A04rAg1KIUJKnKmEb696wLsQhr3NkhN6_E66G-H-kDoGqebJxEuVC9OgP9Su0%3D)
---

I know that you have a lot of political candidates asking for you to make contributions to their campaign, but I’d like you to ask yourself this: how many races could realistically determine whether or not Nancy Pelosi loses the speaker’s gavel next Congress? **Less than 10**.

Thanks for your consideration, Peter

In service,

Alek Skarlatos
Republican for Congress

P.S. Democrats in D.C. just made an investment of $360,000 to help my opponent win. That is A LOT of money in a rural district like mine. TV is cheap and that could just about buy the election for her if we aren't able to counter their attacks.

body:
can't-miss MATCH opportunity >>>
| | |
---
Friend, I'm once again asking you for a contribution while a group of donors is still **_matching all gifts_** that come in before my fundraising deadline. Allow me to explain why this match is so important:
Democrats have accomplished a great deal even with our tenuous 50-50 majority. But just imagine what more we can do with a working majority that won't let the filibuster stand in the way. We can save reproductive freedom, be bolder about confronting the climate crisis and do more to stop gun violence.
We can achieve that by flipping Florida blue – and political experts from CNN are saying _this race_ is one of Democrats' best pickup opportunities. **I'm in this to win, friend, and expand our majority – and three recent polls have shown that I'm in a position to do just that.**
But I simply cannot accomplish all that without resources. | | | | | Peter, **_A former Special Forces General turned radical right-wing Senate nominee for the GOP from New Hampshire has a plan to end our democracy._** **_Think I'm being hyperbolic? Don Bolduc, a full-on MAGA-Republican fascist, called on Americans to "rejoice" when Roe V. Wade was overturned, and he'd fully ban abortion. As Democratic, pro-choice Senator Maggie Hassan--whom we MUST reelect!---put it at the time:_** “He said he would vote for any anti-choice legislation in the U.S. Senate, and that he would never compromise,” **It's chilling.** [**Can you join Blue Amp Action in giving $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford to Senator Maggie Hassan to protect abortion and voting rights?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tea7280e9-4ef4-4636-b096-23a18872e619/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _But, his position on the U.S. Senate may be even more terrifying. He's quietly, along with right-wing cranks, pushed for the repeal of the 17th Amendment.**The 17th Amendment gave Americans the ability to elect Senators in their states a century ago, because in another period of vast corruption, progressives knew state legislatures--who picked U.S. Senators at the time--were easily bought by big money.**_ So, progressives passed the 17th Amendment. And much like getting rid of Social Security or abortion rights, even talking about repealing the 17th Amendment was a fringe, fever swamp idea for the 20th and early 21st Century. But, now, it's championed by the insane Bolduc, and others. **_It is not hyperbole to say if the 17th Amendment were repealed DEMOCRATS WOULD NEVER AGAIN CONTROL THE U.S. SENATE_. **

subject: Puerto Rico
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Working Families Party National PAC (77 Sands St
body:
In times of crisis, it's on all of us to pitch in in whatever ways we are able. It's the idea of community caring for community, no matter how geographically close we may or may not be. | | | Dear Peter, Today is the five year anniversary of when Hurricane Maria made landfall in Puerto Rico, devastating the island. In the five years since, recovery has been slow and the infrastructure of the island remains precarious. So, when Hurricane Fiona made landfall along the southeastern coastline of the island yesterday afternoon — a part of the island that is always hit first and the worst and as of yesterday was still dotted with blue tarps from Hurricane Maria five years ago — it caused catastrophic flooding that left over 75% of the island without clean water today along with an island-wide power outage. That’s over a million people in the dark. And the people of Puerto Rico have no idea when access to either of these resources will be restored. My family lives on the southeastern coastline of Puerto Rico. And I remember five years ago, amidst the devastation and the aftermath of Maria, we couldn’t reach our family for a month. In desperation, I reached out to an organization on the ground and asked them to check on my family members. They did just that — giving my family peace of mind and extending a lifeline to Puerto Ricans in their community. The same organizations that came together to support my family and countless other families on the ground are working together to make sure Puerto Ricans are safe. **In times of crisis, it's on all of us to pitch in in whatever ways we are able. It's the idea of community caring for community, no matter how geographically close we may or may not be.** **[If you're able to donate, consider donating to the Fiona Community Response Fund:](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953zfh-ljwx9RuYYFFGz5HiYU1kYoZu17GMD6WxRjiW3V1_tAsIpzTTHNdNjWmSKAze0QM7pEjW2L7yhE1g38B4o2ZziY8aGxGz5_gbVm7RNbRpbk2VmtTCupjZaql5kw32V5fSLE74kaIHSRCJ1ZoCzuKbbLuNxYfXeXdI-ZxY6sYOikHc-CqbR1qzSS73AScoe8zXMZ6tqgf6xXKoy2jYDhAd53yRgfuxaPYMfbHjViIgKH83TeSKQCoD9_2dvLodCZhJvKE2WLB-xxzcIt1XyjFcCDzDPGvUb4_uYD_ngvrBO0Nnwx7iYmX_ksTsdDGIg/3pm/zpW0zAcnT7uGOP7nJjfXWA/h0/tf3KkZaaseyylVeq8HOUATT1WqtcuNbNXGgtex8f5is)** **[Donate](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953zfh-ljwx9RuYYFFGz5HiYU1kYoZu17GMD6WxRjiW3V1_tAsIpzTTHNdNjWmSKAze0QM7pEjW2L7yhE1g38B4o25mES6ySQgKqtk1qqEr0Fyp5PUjcELtKyxba58aC88f-X4eeTsyNKcvitmSGAYSjT5HHOFPFupDvxS-Lsf4rQGuuvAP8NuKWJnlRnK9VMMRPAJsM1pmaLHGXpmSvA3MBPNAZrL960XuKIJ7vvX2AZs6ulBVbyLhWtJC1XwVpLJjYsM1CE7j9MYii96zY7PycC5umDkf10ErP2WuGachdb_i2xlhTqM0PWKNL96IhoPRo/3pm/zpW0zAcnT7uGOP7nJjfXWA/h1/n-uMqkqTMZRswfmWzWzLEdXHtufbm7BnlzaWWWCVHNw)** The Fund’s aim is, of course, to first address the immediate humanitarian needs of those on the island. But they also intend to help build long-term power for an equitable recovery built by and for Puerto Ricans. In 2021 Puerto Rico’s electric grid was privatized and is now run by a company called Luma, authorized by a federally-imposed oversight board as part of the restructuring of Puerto Rico’s debt. Prior to yesterday’s blackout, the company had already been under scrutiny for frequent blackouts across the island, causing many to worry justifiably. This is the first major hurricane to hit Puerto Rico since privatization and the company is already failing its first major test. But when government fails us, we know that we can count on each other. **[Donate to the Fiona Community Response Fund today and help Puerto Ricans invest in an equitable and lasting recovery.](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953zfh-ljwx9RuYYFFGz5HiYU1kYoZu17GMD6WxRjiW3V1_tAsIpzTTHNdNjWmSKAze0QM7pEjW2L7yhE1g38B4o2IsFFycCqU_9PCv2FclzjyHcsqRq_LGAekNz-QYf9OvbF0EQM-PIyV6rc0NrSpi9ovNcDYzlmGByf5TgwcZ1AvL7nzvJpHWQYNnqlovE2ptzIzkvTgaNk1cRRPI1l3uhUruurAgyGB0aHeEM4hAiK2vGd00dbcDOD6sbinHDB76QhmYnFDkmrW1pS_Lyydd11f4ep1UcJ8ii0uMiHLRRitB1Rpm01k9WirOwFRVHa9nk/3pm/zpW0zAcnT7uGOP7nJjfXWA/h2/yvllz7V0SzEygduyy0qlmNWLqvFBLkxyYP_ZDotTiNI)** **[Donate](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953zfh-ljwx9RuYYFFGz5HiYU1kYoZu17GMD6WxRjiW3V1_tAsIpzTTHNdNjWmSKAze0QM7pEjW2L7yhE1g38B4o2izrWEJsxu-dDYiPIK-lbfj8pTf7XWJQDkYj7pMkvWpmQpFcuumwn_cmhdPrKlqPBuNT97WoCPAlGHzH4W1m-re2pRaOgedoYYqW2qL9axvLPRjqprY9Wj9OfZ6zEQQ1cYqVRi0kslR_TVemnGk1bvQSefFwfOj9SZm4CV5uM1g71CBXrdsHbprFyl-BHV7blco8vxfF6BzO-yGTAA0a-MjBZFSxLEcTIXEAxG8_15wU/3pm/zpW0zAcnT7uGOP7nJjfXWA/h3/3vP2scOSqwyc3E2MnA1-ME4Bs39pmoXCU4C3nfT_tV4)** In solidarity, Nelini Stamp

clean_body: In times of crisis, it's on all of us to pitch in in whatever ways we are able. It's the idea of community caring for community, no matter how geographically close we may or may not be. | | | Dear Peter, Today is the five year anniversary of when Hurricane Maria made landfall in Puerto Rico, devastating the island. In the five years since, recovery has been slow and the infrastructure of the island remains precarious. So, when Hurricane Fiona made landfall along the southeastern coastline of the island yesterday afternoon — a part of the island that is always hit first and the worst and as of yesterday was still dotted with blue tarps from Hurricane Maria five years ago — it caused catastrophic flooding that left over 75% of the island without clean water today along with an island-wide power outage. That’s over a million people in the dark. And the people of Puerto Rico have no idea when access to either of these resources will be restored. My family lives on the southeastern coastline of Puerto Rico. And I remember five years ago, amidst the devastation and the aftermath of Maria, we couldn’t reach our family for a month. In desperation, I reached out to an organization on the ground and asked them to check on my family members. They did just that — giving my family peace of mind and extending a lifeline to Puerto Ricans in their community. The same organizations that came together to support my family and countless other families on the ground are working together to make sure Puerto Ricans are safe. In times of crisis, it's on all of us to pitch in in whatever ways we are able. It's the idea of community caring for community, no matter how geographically close we may or may not be. The Fund’s aim is, of course, to first address the immediate humanitarian needs of those on the island. But they also intend to help build long-term power for an equitable recovery built by and for Puerto Ricans. In 2021 Puerto Rico’s electric grid was privatized and is now run by a company called Luma, authorized by a federally-imposed oversight board as part of the restructuring of Puerto Rico’s debt. Prior to yesterday’s blackout, the company had already been under scrutiny for frequent blackouts across the island, causing many to worry justifiably. This is the first major hurricane to hit Puerto Rico since privatization and the company is already failing its first major test. But when government fails us, we know that we can count on each other. In solidarity, Nelini Stamp Working Families Party Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. Peter,

**Today is National Voter Registration Day**. Before I began running for office, I would have had no clue the significance of September 20th on the calendar.

Major political handicappers consider the congressional district I’m running in just slightly more Democrat than Republican, meaning It’s no more likely to vote Democrat than it is Republican. Depending on the climate of the general electorate -- and the candidate -- the district could send a socialist to Congress or a Republican.

It’s clear that I’m not going to win over any Democrat voters at this point in time. That said, our recent polling indicates that we still have room to improve with Republicans. **[I need to be sure that we’re able to reach every Republican voter in the district to confirm whether they are registered and know they have a candidate who can WIN](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=3d648451558440039cef3b84924db8d4&_e=jZiAmy_jf1TvRZXbwOtHRd4Y0MgpQoa8PWDxUs5VVajnKlHynq7kfMiyX0KmsHoOvt_GOsEk0KLIzTWkuPDaEVc4KjJqlJt9qIy28wqo_VJ-3Olq-p7BVG2Y871HIxeI9pUiaY_rW4PFTYbAh3mZprDolQvXBbSBYbwyXyEDVphpVKMJCahO-xhyrsv8BIe8eD_ut0mb2JjedmQ-OuUh_jIG4ORGa1GOLJcNP1NVKDECpKJ2aKZH7tP3UlyaMiYPurHpfZsSMUXQS-5a8SmbI3dZcAbVU0knhjaT7Oepz90a6Jf0R2_ldyxOuaGh8r7IFJaTtMASpfshzwc3LEQgr8WYKpPuNSfLBSWM4ssU-y9JaOWSdF_J77rMfM50JSwH)**.

[ Help Me Reach Every Voter➔ ](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=3d648451558440039cef3b84924db8d4&_e=jZiAmy_jf1TvRZXbwOtHRd4Y0MgpQoa8PWDxUs5VVajnKlHynq7kfMiyX0KmsHoOvt_GOsEk0KLIzTWkuPDaEVc4KjJqlJt9qIy28wqo_VJ-3Olq-p7BVG2Y871HIxeI9pUiaY_rW4PFTYbAh3mZprDolQvXBbSBYbwyXyEDVphpVKMJCahO-xhyrsv8BIe8eD_ut0mb2JjedmQ-OuUh_jIG4ORGa1GOLJcNP1NVKDHe2GnG0OFD45w9j9HFtsi_9doDuT9fxni8kyPLcQVwtE5gZVwS7ph-a47oCH1zy2PeMWrNz9Sp2KRHmPWGDiU-SEtutY73f9t5QCWYwcUSm6tKicv3Gj5Zq5_5x8ZNaT78GU5A3Y90k34yJ1satsYH)
However, the voting block that will decide whether I win or lose on Election Day are the undecided voters. While they may be small in number, they pack a big punch. Most of these voters are not affiliated with a party, so it’s our duty from now until Election Day to persuade them to vote for me on November 8th.**[We also need to ensure this core group of targeted voters are registered to vote](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=3d648451558440039cef3b84924db8d4&_e=jZiAmy_jf1TvRZXbwOtHRd4Y0MgpQoa8PWDxUs5VVajnKlHynq7kfMiyX0KmsHoOvt_GOsEk0KLIzTWkuPDaEVc4KjJqlJt9qIy28wqo_VJ-3Olq-p7BVG2Y871HIxeI9pUiaY_rW4PFTYbAh3mZprDolQvXBbSBYbwyXyEDVphpVKMJCahO-xhyrsv8BIe8eD_ut0mb2JjedmQ-OuUh_jIG4ORGa1GOLJcNP1NVKDFXhH1ge1DqWsZALIJAsq1sGOzwo7eVvp17QuNuE3lJWoeeDUdygm-optKQqYn56L1ZeOMPnO3Bdix0Es7ywclCXiL9N4UUJhBjVHvhiqUHAY1UDyjhaUrFqDDUOuXgtK2mGrKxoEY0FV7Q6IqTzuMa)**.

The deadline to register to vote in Oregon is October 18th – so we have our work cut out for us. On average, we’re seeing that it costs $4 to reach a targeted voter in my district. **[On this National Voter Registration Day, would you consider a gift to my campaign of $4 or more to help us make sure no voter is left behind?](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=3d648451558440039cef3b84924db8d4&_e=jZiAmy_jf1TvRZXbwOtHRd4Y0MgpQoa8PWDxUs5VVajnKlHynq7kfMiyX0KmsHoOvt_GOsEk0KLIzTWkuPDaEVc4KjJqlJt9qIy28wqo_VJ-3Olq-p7BVG2Y871HIxeI9pUiaY_rW4PFTYbAh3mZprDolQvXBbSBYbwyXyEDVphpVKMJCahO-xhyrsv8BIe8eD_ut0mb2JjedmQ-OuUh_jIG4ORGa1GOLJcNP1NVKDHkX6DH-1bEd4XnKEBpYvZ4pMoynFrTNMXqPgOzgrMJ6OFNV2w-lLatwBZT2XtqeU5krWiU-tztKpqA3M5lFdfqefBFOpVR2vF5lG-l093tZdaeJj_T7o2QsMoK0oqq3ZLQ8Jv1uNBCqwps3ipB3ypn)**

name: Laurie Teper
subject: 30 days until Early Voting!
body:
Hey Team Geels!

The time is ticking as we approach early voting and Election Day! Courtney and her team (YOU) have put in a lot of work, time, and energy thus far. WE CAN'T QUIT NOW!
455 people have signed up to _volunteer to date!_ YOU are one of them! Can we count on YOU to be at one of our 162 precincts over 5 counties for early voting and on Election Day? This is critical. If every person receiving this email says "Yes, I want Courtney to win. Yes, I understand it takes commitment and time. Yes, I will do everything I can to help. NO, I DON'T WANT VALERIE FOUSHEE REPRESENTING ME AND MY VALUES IN CONGRESS.", then we can have every slot filled! Please SIGN UP TO VOLUNTEER for Election Day and early voting. WE NEED YOU! Contact your County Coordinator and expect a call from someone who will get you signed up.
Volunteer training is available from Courtney on several dates and times in October leading up to early voting. You have several options to choose from. Please contact your _County Coordinator_ (See below) for the date and time that works best for you and he/she will send you the link to hop on the call. This should only take 20 minutes of your time. The following dates/times are when Courtney has set aside to train you.

10/3- 9pm
10/4- 7am
10/5- 12noon
10/6- 7am
10/19- 7am
10/19- 9pm

Courtney has reached out to Valerie Foushee's Campaign several times asking for a town hall or a debate. NO RESPONSE! She is avoiding Courtney Geels like the plague! Please flood her with emails and phone calls with requests for all voters to hear them speak and talk about the issues that matter to their constituents!

919-733-5804

[Valerie.Foushee@ncleg.gov](mailto:Valerie.Foushee@ncleg.gov)

_UPCOMING EVENTS AND NEEDS!_

_Person County Door Knocking - NEED VOLUNTEERS!_
Saturday, Sept. 24 8:30am
Rock City Grill
25c Old Durham Rd, Roxboro, NC 27573

Please consider joining us as we GOTV! Contact Laurie at [volunteers@courtneygeelsforcongress.com](mailto:volunteers@courtneygeelsforcongress.com) to tell me you will be there ASAP. BONUS! I will buy you lunch afterwards.

_TUNE IN TO SPECTRUM NEWS!!_
The interviews that Valerie Foushee and Courtney Geels taped will air on Spectrum News
from 12-1 pm and then again from 8-9 pm on Sunday, September 25.

_YARD SIGNS_
Courtney Geels Signs can officially be put out on public property beginning September 20!
If you want to help, contact your County Coordinator for details.

If you see a large sign out that needs mowing around, contact me! We have someone willing to do that.

_Little River Presbyterian Church BBQ & Chicken Supper_
Saturday, September 24
4:00pm-7:00pn
Place: Schley Grange Hall
Show up wearing your CG shirts! Have palm cards? Bring them with and hand them out as you engage with people.

_Grahamtoberfest in Downtown Graham_
_Saturday Sept.24_
_3:00pm-10:00pm_
_103 Elm St_
Have fun at this event wearing your CG shirts! Have palm cards? Bring them with and hand them out as you engage with people.
<https://www.visitalamance.com/event/grahamtoberfest-downtown-graham/23904/>

_
_
_Federal Candidate Forum_

Place: Dogwood Alliance Town Hall

Date: September 21st, 2022
Time: 7PM to 10PM
North Carolina State University, Stewart Theatre
2610 Cates Ave, Raleigh, NC 27695
Show up wearing your CG shirts!
<https://www.dogwoodalliance.org/readyyourvote/>

**_Prayer Team_**
If you feel led to cover this campaign in prayer weekly on Monday mornings at 10am with a team virtually, contact me - [volunteers@courtneygeelsforcongress.com](mailto:volunteers@courtneygeelsforcongress.com)
**
**
**Contact WRAL and your local radio and TV stations! Flood their emails every day!**
We are working on trying to set up an interview with WRAL. Please email the station and tell them you want to hear from Courtney. Tell others to do the same! Use this link to contact them:
<https://www.wral.com/Contact-Us/1007423/>

Share this link with potential **volunteers** to sign up:

<https://courtneygeelsforcongress.com/volunteer/>

Share this link with potential **donors to donate** :
<https://secure.winred.com/courtney-geels-for-congress/donate-today>

Please take videos and photos (in a vertical position) at any event and send them to our Social Media Director, Caroline Johnson at [caroline@bluemeraldmedia.com.](http://caroline@bluemeraldmedia.com./)

Your County Coordinators:
_Person_ : Jason Chambers - [JWCham8786@gmail.com](mailto:JWCham8786@gmail.com)
_Orange_ : Marianne Link - [marianne@courtneygeelsforcongress.com](mailto:marianne@courtneygeelsforcongress.com)
_Alamance_ : Corrie Shepherd - [Corrieshep@gmail.com](mailto:Corrieshep@gmail.com)
_Durham_ : Renee Hill - [rhill632@aol.com](mailto:rhill632@aol.com)
_Granville_ : Noah & Abigail Pruitt - [noah@courtneygeelsforcongress.com](mailto:noah@courtneygeelsforcongress.com)

Follow us on [Twitter](https://twitter.com/courtneygeels), [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/courtneygeels/), and give us a like on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/CourtneyGeelsForCongress) to keep up with Courtney.

Be sure to like and share!

__Fighting for Truth, Justice and Unity Together!__
Laurie Teper
Volunteer Director
Courtney Geels for Congress NC04
Email: [volunteers@courtneygeelsforcongress.com](mailto:volunteers@courtneygeelsforcongress.com)
Cell: (847)212-5651
[courtneygeelsforcongress.com](http://courtneygeelsforcongress.com)

Please allow me to explain. No one disputes that crime is skyrocketing in New Mexico. We’re setting murder records and everyone has their own crime story. **However, since MLG has been governor, the prison population in New Mexico has been reduced by 20%.** That alone is a damning and indefensible fact that puts to lie any claim MLG can make saying she’s tough on crime. Our crime crisis – and the fact state prisons are being emptied – are related and the direct result of MLG’s leftwing politics. One of the first things MLG did was to put the most liberal politician in Santa Fe in charge of the parole board. The same guy who consistently sided with criminals and against crime victims in the state Senate...the same guy who **voted against** Baby Brianna’s Law...the guy who believes child abusers who kill their victims should be paroled after 12 years is now in charge of parole under MLG. She put him there because she knew he would implement her leftwing agenda on the parole board, which is to let more criminals out of prison. She then appointed liberal judges all over the state who continually let criminals out of jail and repeatedly sentenced violent criminals to light sentences, like probation**,**** ** over and over again. **And MLG went a step further – she personally ordered the early release of dangerous criminals from prison**. She said it was for COVID, but she’s never stopped. To this day, she is continuing to release criminals from prison early. She commuted the sentences of convicted criminals, including violent criminals, saying that these criminals were ready to be our neighbors. Unsurprisingly, many of the criminals whose sentences she commuted went on to commit even more crimes against innocent New Mexicans. **These are all reasons why the prison population in New Mexico is down 20% since MLG took office, despite the fact crime is skyrocketing.** These are also reasons criminal defense lawyers and supporters of “Catch and Release” are bankrolling MLG’s campaign. _**If New Mexico voters learn of these facts, we will win this election in a landslide. **_ But our challenge is**,****** New Mexicans won’t learn any of this in the media. We’re running a different type of campaign. I respect your intelligence and that’s why I’m sending you this detailed email laying out the reasons MLG has created a crime crisis in New Mexico and explaining how, together, we can win this campaign and turn things around in the state we all love. Please allow me to explain. No one disputes that crime is skyrocketing in New Mexico. We’re setting murder records and everyone has their own crime story. However, since MLG has been governor, the prison population in New Mexico has been reduced by 20%. That alone is a damning and indefensible fact that puts to lie any claim MLG can make saying she’s tough on crime. Our crime crisis – and the fact state prisons are being emptied – are related and the direct result of MLG’s leftwing politics. One of the first things MLG did was to put the most liberal politician in Santa Fe in charge of the parole board. The same guy who consistently sided with criminals and against crime victims in the state Senate...the same guy who voted against Baby Brianna’s Law...the guy who believes child abusers who kill their victims should be paroled after 12 years is now in charge of parole under MLG. She put him there because she knew he would implement her leftwing agenda on the parole board, which is to let more criminals out of prison. She then appointed liberal judges all over the state who continually let criminals out of jail and repeatedly sentenced violent criminals to light sentences, like probation, over and over again. And MLG went a step further – she personally ordered the early release of dangerous criminals from prison. She said it was for COVID, but she’s never stopped. To this day, she is continuing to release criminals from prison early. She commuted the sentences of convicted criminals, including violent criminals, saying that these criminals were ready to be our neighbors. Unsurprisingly, many of the criminals whose sentences she commuted went on to commit even more crimes against innocent New Mexicans. These are all reasons why the prison population in New Mexico is down 20% since MLG took office, despite the fact crime is skyrocketing. These are also reasons criminal defense lawyers and supporters of “Catch and Release” are bankrolling MLG’s campaign. If New Mexico voters learn of these facts, we will win this election in a landslide. But our challenge is,** New Mexicans won’t learn any of this in the media. Unfortunately, there is a lot MLG has done to make New Mexico less safe and that means there is a lot we need to communicate to voters. One of MLG’s first acts was to remove the National Guard from the border. This made it much easier for drug traffickers to get drugs like fentanyl into our state. Fentanyl is now killing one New Mexican each and every day. She also made New Mexico a sanctuary state and supported local governments who did the same. These laws directly contribute to our crime crisis. You see, sanctuary laws aren’t about protecting migrants, despite what the Left says – these laws protect criminals. Because the only people who benefit from sanctuary laws are illegal immigrants who are arrested for committing crimes by the police. The impact of these laws on our crime crisis has gone completely unreported by the media. Since January of this year, records show that over 300 likely illegal immigrants have been arrested (and released) in Bernalillo County. Illegal immigrants who committed crimes like murder, child abuse, and armed robbery have been protected from deportation under the MLG-supported sanctuary laws in one county alone. That means ICE was never notified of their arrests. So instead of these criminals being detained in jail pending deportation proceedings, these criminals were released right back onto our streets, most of the time within a day or two. Don’t you think voters need to learn about these cases? This is yet another reason why dangerous drug gangs choose to operate in New Mexico. In fact, the FBI recently made its biggest bust in the national history of the organization in Albuquerque last month. Members of the gang told the FBI the reason they’re in New Mexico is because of our weak laws. We’re a sanctuary state with catch and release. Because we don’t have a 3-strikes law, these drug gangs are more scared to operate in liberal California than New Mexico. Don’t take my word for it – that’s exactly what they told the FBI in official court records. Those are all items I address in my crime plan – ending catch and release, enacting a real 3-strikes law, appointing conservative judges, ending early release, and giving law enforcement the support they deserve. You can read my full plan here: "" Again, we can’t expect the media to hold the governor accountable and inform the public of these facts. Even when the biggest fentanyl bust in the history of the FBI is made in Albuquerque. Even when the gang members involved in the bust tell the FBI they’re in New Mexico due to our weak laws. The media still won’t even ask the governor a single question about it. But that’s ok. The good news is that we don’t have to rely on the media to get the truth to voters. Our television, internet and radio ads, along with our mailers, will reach voters directly. But these advertisements cost money and that’s why I’m asking for your most generous contribution today. ** Everywhere I go people come up to me excited about this campaign and the positive changes we will make in New Mexico. I see the sincere hope in their eyes and that’s why I’m so confident we will win this campaign. And when we do, we will make sure New Mexico’s best days are ahead of us. body:
| |
---
| | | | [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61346050:6IZ_kcVNG:m:1:3331421248:D69C334E3FA33C2E09424DCD73E7B234:r "This is why I'm running")
---

Peter,

I know you're busy, but I need just a few minutes of your time.

__**[This is why I'm running.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61346050:6IZ_kcVNG:m:1:3331421248:D69C334E3FA33C2E09424DCD73E7B234:r "This is why
I’m running.")**__

I grew up on a small farm in Washington.

We didn't have much, but I learned the value of hard work at a young age. I learned _responsibility_. That is something that political elites will never understand.

As a former triage nurse, I have always been passionate about serving others in my community.

However, everything was tested when a suicide bomber in Iraq permanently blinded my husband, Scotty, and I was told his service was over.
_**The suicide bomber may have taken my husband's vision, but he didn 't take away our determination and drive for service over self.**_
That's how I found myself running against a 30-year Democrat incumbent because we deserve better.

With empty grocery shelves and unprecedented crime, I couldn't sit on the sidelines any longer.

_**[This country is worth serving and sacrificing for, but I need YOUR endorsement to continue my fight!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61346050:6IZ_kcVNG:m:1:3331421248:D69C334E3FA33C2E09424DCD73E7B234:r "This country is worth serving and
sacrificing for, but I need YOUR endorsement to continue my fight!")**_

I'm not asking for money. _Today, all I 'm asking for is your endorsement. _

---
| | [ENDORSE TIFFANY SMILEY](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61346050:6IZ_kcVNG:m:1:3331421248:D69C334E3FA33C2E09424DCD73E7B234:r "ENDORSE TIFFANY SMILEY")
---

We're just weeks away from the General Election, and I know the odds are against me.

However, I genuinely believe that America needs to restore its core values. If you think that too, please, _**[endorse me and join our team.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61346050:6IZ_kcVNG:m:1:3331421248:D69C334E3FA33C2E09424DCD73E7B234:r "endorse me and join our team.")**_

It would mean the world to me.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

subject: This is who we’ve always been.

body:
Just because the melanin has changed doesn’t mean the people or the institutions are any different.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220920-3409-header&t=1&akid=3409%2E2526796%2EiWOO-d)
If you don’t follow me on Instagram, you may have missed my recent story about what happened in Martha’s Vineyard.
Governor of Florida, Ron Desantis, recently paid to fly 48 Venezuelan migrants from San Antonio, TX to Martha’s Vineyard, MA. Lured under false promises of work opportunities in Boston, these migrants were tricked in an act of political theater.1
This is what I had to say about that on IG:
My community, NY-14’s Congressional District, is nearly 50% immigrant. We speak over 100 languages, we have two public hospitals, treat everyone regardless of ability to pay, and we have enough left over to help Florida because **New York is a net tax exporter to the rest of the country, and Florida is a net tax taker.**
So while Ron DeSantis and Greg Abbott want to act like they’re all economically savvy...DeSantis can’t even produce an economy that actually contributes to the United States overall. And we’re happy to help. But a big reason we’re able to? Why? **Because of immigrants.** Documented, undocumented, everything.
So just because your great-great-grandpa was able to come into the United States on a post-it note doesn’t mean he’s any better than the people who are arriving at Martha’s Vineyard today. Doesn’t mean that he’s any better; or that your family, or that anybody’s ancestors are any more documented or legitimate than the people coming in from Honduras, Bangladesh, or anywhere else.
This is who we’ve always been. And just because the melanin has changed doesn’t mean the people or the institutions are any different. They are a blessing to us. They bring abundance. And maybe if we learn that, Florida would actually be able to contribute to the United States in terms of their taxes and take a lesson from New York.
Talk soon,
Alexandria
P.S. If you want to catch my full Instagram story on this, [you can watch here](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14909?t=2&akid=3409%2E2526796%2EiWOO-d).

Democratic champions like Mark Kelly, Maggie Hassan, Raphael Warnock, and Catherine Cortez Masto are all up for re-election in just a few weeks -- and we’re looking at four _extremely close_ races. _One loss_ could be _devastating._

**I’m not exaggerating when I tell you that $5 from supporters like you could decide our political future.** But right now, we’re still waiting on a contribution from you today, and I know you wouldn’t miss out on a chance like this to be a real difference-maker.

He says he's trying to grow his pack every single day. = He says he needs lots of people in his pack so that he can make a really BIG blue wave. I'm still trying to figure that out, but it sounds VERY IMPORTANT! Almost as important as snuggles! = = Anyway, time to go for another walk. | | Fellow Georgians,

Republicans have launched an all out assault on our democracy itself, and it’s put people like me — a Black Congressman representing rural Georgia — in danger of losing my seat.

[**_I’ve never faced an election challenge like this before. Can you split $25 between my campaign and the Democratic Party of Georgia to defend my seat and the House majority?_**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51048744/368074591/1670963304?refcode=20220920.5_SB_9CI_A&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA4MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjM2YxYzJlZS0zZjM5LWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=QXvp66VLvlNPHYR0zwM1emw_EYtORNgNhMOwIRoLlHA=)

We know when Republicans win, it leads to failing schools, shuttered hospitals, and a lack of support for our rural communities. We have to keep fighting for our democracy, for unity, and for a renewed faith in the promise of America.

**Simply put: it’s going to be tough.**

Here in Georgia, Republicans are furious after we beat them so badly last cycle. First, they passed a shameful voter suppression bill designed to restrict access to the ballot box for poor, elderly, rural, and non-white Georgians. Then, they redrew my seat to make it harder for me to win again.

And now, national Republicans are pouring more money than they ever have into Georgia, — the NRCC has released attack ad after attack ad against me!

**If we can’t defend seats like mine this cycle, Democrats WILL lose the House.**

_[**But to stay on track to win in November, I need to raise $15,000 by tonight at midnight.
